english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Heberi ũrĩa Mũkeni nĩeyamũrĩte agatigana na Akeni arĩa angĩ a rũciaro rwa Hobabu, mũthoni-we wa Musa,* na akaamba hema yake mũtĩ-inĩ ũrĩa mũnene kũu Zaananimu gũkuhĩ na Kadeshi.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

kikuyu: No Musa akiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, ndagũthaitha tũma mũndũ ũngĩ akaarie.”
english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

kikuyu: O na ningĩ kuuma harĩ inyuĩ nĩgũkoimĩra andũ, na mogomie ũhoro-wa-ma nĩgeetha maguucĩrĩrie arutwo mamarũmĩrĩre.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũceeri na andũ aingĩ aahota kwĩyũnũhithia,
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmarora akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ũndũ ũcio ndũngĩhoteka nĩ andũ, no maũndũ mothe nĩmahotekaga nĩ Ngai.”
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

kikuyu: ũtĩ wa keerĩ wagwĩrĩire mũhĩrĩga wa Simeoni, kũringana na ũrĩa mbarĩ ciao ciatariĩ. Igai rĩao rĩarĩ thĩinĩ wa bũrũri wa Juda.
english: he second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa wĩtigagĩra Jehova hĩndĩ ciothe, no ũrĩa ũmagia ngoro yake nĩkũgũa agũũaga thĩĩna-inĩ.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Metha ciothe ciyũrĩte matahĩko, na gũtirĩ handũ o na hamwe hataiyũrĩte gĩko.
english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

kikuyu: Wacookete ũgathiĩ na mbere kuuma Betheli (na nokuo Luzu), ũkaringa ũgakinya bũrũri wa Aariki o kũu Atarothu,
english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa maathiire na mbere kũmũũria ũhoro ũcio, akĩinamũka, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo harĩ na ũmwe wanyu ũtarĩ ehia-rĩ, nĩatuĩke wa mbere kũmũikĩria ihiga.”
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Hanuni akĩnyiitithia andũ acio a Daudi, na akĩmenjithia nderu rwere rũmwe, na agĩtinia nguo ciao irima gatagatĩ ka njikarĩro, na akĩmaingata.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

kikuyu: Ndĩmwandĩkĩire ũndũ ũyũ ndĩ na ũũmĩrĩru mũingĩ ngĩmwĩra maũndũ mamwe, taarĩ kũmũririkania maũndũ macio rĩngĩ, nĩ ũndũ wa wega ũrĩa Ngai aaheire,
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, gũtirĩ ndungata nene gũkĩra mwathi wayo, kana mũtũmwo agakĩra ũrĩa ũmũtũmĩte.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩruta watho nĩ ũndũ wao, akĩarĩria Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, na atongoria a nyũmba cia mĩhĩrĩga ya andũ a Isiraeli,
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: na Zanoa, na Adulamu na tũtũũra twarĩo, na Lakishi na mĩgũnda ya rĩo, na Azeka na matũũra marĩo. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio maatũũraga kuuma Birishiba o nginya Kĩanda kĩa Hinomu.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa wacihe irio, cioyaga ikarĩa; rĩrĩa watambũrũkia guoko gwaku, ũcihũũnagia na indo njega.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

kikuyu: na nĩo ariũ ikũmi a Hamani mũrũ wa Hamedatha, ũrĩa warĩ thũ ya Ayahudi. No matiigana gũtaha indo ciao.
english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa mahaandaga na maithori, nĩmakagetha makĩinaga nyĩmbo cia gĩkeno.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, nĩ kwarĩ na mũndũ ũmwe wa kuuma Ramathaimu, Mũzofimu kuuma bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Efiraimu, nake eetagwo Elikana mũrũ wa Jerohamu, mũrũ wa Elihu, mũrũ wa Tohu, mũrũ wa Zufu, Mũefiraimu.
english: ow there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

kikuyu: Nĩacũũranirie na agĩtuĩria maũndũ, na agĩtabanĩria thimo nyingĩ na mũbango. Mũrutani nĩatuĩririe nĩgeetha one ciugo o iria ciagĩrĩire, na ũrĩa aandĩkire warĩ mũrũngĩrĩru na wa ma.
english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, wee ũikaraga mĩgũnda-inĩ hamwe na arata a thiritũ yaku, reke o na niĩ njigue mũgambo waku. Mwendwa
english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice! Beloved

kikuyu: Nao arutwo ake magĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Tũngĩruta kũ mĩgate ya kũhũũnia kĩrĩndĩ ta gĩkĩ, gũkũ werũ- inĩ?”
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

kikuyu: Na mwĩkĩre maguta na ũbani igũrũ rĩayo; rĩu nĩ iruta rĩa mũtu.
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Nake Jehu akĩĩra mũikaria wa harĩa nguo ciaigagwo atĩrĩ, “Rehere ndungata ciothe cia Baali nguo.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩcirehere nguo.
english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

kikuyu: Maatungataga na ũini Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo o nginya rĩrĩa Solomoni aakire hekarũ ya Jehova kũu Jerusalemu. Nao maarutaga wĩra wao kũringana na mawatho marĩa maatuĩtwo.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio haarĩ na buremu inyanya na itina ikũmi na ithathatũ cia betha; o igĩrĩ igaikarĩrwo nĩ buremu ĩmwe.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio airĩtu acio eerĩ a Loti makĩgĩa nda na ithe wao.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

kikuyu: Saũlũ aagerete mwena ũmwe wa kĩrĩma, nake Daudi na andũ ake makagerera mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ, mahiũhĩte nĩguo morĩre Saũlũ. Na rĩrĩa Saũlũ na thigari ciake maakuhagĩrĩria Daudi na andũ ake nĩguo mamanyiite-rĩ,
english: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli othe moonire mwaki ũkiuma na igũrũ, na riiri wa Jehova ũrĩ igũrũ rĩa hekarũ, magĩturia maru hau haarĩtwo mahiga, maturumithĩtie mothiũ mao thĩ, makĩhooya Jehova na makĩmũcookeria ngaatho, makiugaga atĩrĩ, “Jehova nĩ mwega; wendo wake ũtũũraga nginya tene.”
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

kikuyu: no inyuĩ nĩndĩmũũĩ. Ngamenya atĩ inyuĩ mũtirĩ na wendo wa Ngai ngoro-inĩ cianyu.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

kikuyu: Ndũkanamĩrĩe, nĩguo maũndũ maku magĩrĩre, o na ma ciana ciaku iria igooka thuutha waku, tondũ ũrĩkoragwo ũgĩĩka maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire maitho-inĩ ma Jehova.
english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

kikuyu: Mũtongoria mũnene wa Alawii kũu Jerusalemu aarĩ Uzi mũrũ wa Bani, mũrũ wa Hashabia, mũrũ wa Matania, mũrũ wa Mika. Uzi aarĩ ũmwe wa rũciaro rwa Asafu, arĩa maarĩ aini arĩa maarũgamĩrĩire wĩra wa nyũmba ya Ngai.
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo hagĩũka mũndũ, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ta rorai! Andũ arĩa mũraikirie njeera marũgamĩte hekarũ-inĩ makĩruta andũ.”
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

kikuyu: Wee thiĩ ũkuhĩrĩrie, ũigue ũrĩa wothe Jehova Ngai witũ ekuuga. Ũcooke ũũke ũtwĩre ũrĩa wothe Jehova Ngai witũ egũkwĩra. Nĩtũkũigua na twathĩke.”
english: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

kikuyu: na matũũra mothe ma Sihoni mũthamaki wa Aamori, ũrĩa wathamakaga Heshiboni, nginya o mũhaka wa Aamoni.
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Solomoni nĩ aarĩ na andũ 70,000 a gũkuua mĩrigo, na aicũhia a mahiga 80,000 kũu irĩma-inĩ,
english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

kikuyu: na Hodia, na Bani, na Beninu.
english: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ:
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ariũ a Isiraeli magĩĩka o ro ũguo. Jusufu akĩmahe makaari o ta ũrĩa Firaũni aathanĩte na agĩcooka akĩmahe rĩĩgu wa rũgendo rwao.
english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mwĩhumbei Mwathani Jesũ Kristũ, na mũtigatũũre mwĩciiragia o ũrĩa mũngĩhingia merirĩria ma mĩĩrĩ ĩno ya mehia.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

kikuyu: Anene acio ethĩ maatongoragia mbũtũ cia bũrũri nĩo maathiire mbere. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Beni-Hadadi nĩatũmĩte andũ a gũthigaana, nao makĩmũrehere ũhoro atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kũrĩ na andũ marooka moimĩte Samaria.”
english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũrata wakwa, ĩka ũrĩa ũũkire gwĩka.” Nao andũ acio makĩmũguthũkĩra, makĩmũnyiita.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

kikuyu: Nake akĩambĩrĩria kwaria na ũcamba kũu thunagogi-inĩ. Rĩrĩa Pirisila na Akula maamũiguire akĩaria, makĩmũnyiita ũgeni kwao mũciĩ na makĩmũtaarĩria ũhoro wa njĩra ya Ngai wega makĩria.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ acio makĩoya iheo icio na betha maita meerĩ, na magĩthiĩ na Benjamini. Magĩikũrũka na ihenya Misiri na makĩĩneana kũrĩ Jusufu.
english: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

kikuyu: Elisha akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe atũũraga muoyo, ũrĩa niĩ ndungatagĩra, tiga nĩ ũndũ wa gũconokera Jehoshafatu mũthamaki wa Juda-rĩ, niĩ ndingĩak- wĩhũgũrĩra o na kana nyone ta wĩ ho.
english: Elisha said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

kikuyu: Rahai Jehova, mũheane ũhoro wa riiri wa rĩĩtwa rĩake; thathaiyai Jehova thĩinĩ wa ũkengi wa ũthingu wake.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũrĩĩaga nyama cia mĩĩrĩ ya andũ akwa, mũkamonũra ikonde na mũkoinanga mahĩndĩ mao tũcunjĩ; O inyuĩ mũmatinangagia ta nyama cia gũkarangwo na rũgĩo, o na ta nyama cia gũtherũkio na nyũngũ.”
english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

kikuyu: Ta tuai arĩ inyuĩ: Nĩ kwagĩrĩire mũndũ-wa-nja kũhooya Ngai atehumbĩrĩte mũtwe?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

kikuyu: Na nĩmamwĩrire maũndũ mangĩ maingĩ ma kũmũruma. Jesũ Mbere ya Pilato na Herode
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, mbere yakwa gũtũire kwandĩkĩtwo maũndũ macio: ndigũtũũra ngirĩte ki, no rĩrĩ, nĩngarĩhanĩria kũna; ti-itherũ ngaarĩhanĩria o ciero-inĩ ciao,
english: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom

kikuyu: Adoni-Bezeki akĩũra, no makĩmũtengʼeria, makĩmũnyiita, makĩmũtinia ciara iria nene cia moko na iria nene cia magũrũ.†
english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

kikuyu: Maitho maku maroikara marorete hekarũ ĩno mũthenya na ũtukũ, o handũ haha wee woigire atĩ nĩũgatũma Rĩĩtwa rĩaku rĩkoragwo ho. Ũroigua ihooya rĩrĩa ndungata yaku ĩrĩhooyaga ĩrorete handũ haha.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngatũma maaĩ makuo mahoorere, na ndũme tũrũũĩ twakuo tũtherere ta maguta, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ningĩ andũ a Dameski,* tondũ wa indo ciaku nyingĩ na ũtonga waku mũnene wa indo, nĩmarutithanirie wĩra wa kwonjorithia nawe wa wendia wa ndibei ya kuuma Helibona, na guoya wa ngʼondu wa kuuma Zaharu.
english: “ ‘ “Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

kikuyu: Mĩrango yothe yarĩ na buremu cia mĩena ĩna; yekĩrĩtwo mwena wa na mbere ĩtatũ ĩtatũ, ĩngʼethanĩire.
english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mwatuĩkire a kwĩgerekania na ithuĩ, o na mũgĩtuĩka a kwĩgerekania na Mwathani, o na gũtuĩka mwarĩ na mĩnyamaro mĩingĩ, nĩmwamũkĩrire ũhoro wake mũrĩ na gĩkeno kĩrĩa kĩheanagwo nĩ Roho Mũtheru.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũmwe wa Thabatũ, Jesũ nĩathiire kũrĩa irio nyũmba ya mũnene ũmwe wa Afarisai, nao andũ maikarĩte mamũrorete mũno.
english: hen he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

kikuyu: na Hanani, na Gideli, na Gaharu,
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

kikuyu: Mahinda makwa marĩ moko-inĩ maku; ndeithũra kuuma kũrĩ thũ ciakwa, na kuuma kũrĩ arĩa maathingataga.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ! Nĩ ngaari ya gũkuua Solomoni, yumagarĩtio nĩ njamba cia ita mĩrongo ĩtandatũ, iria ndĩĩe mũno cia Isiraeli,
english: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo o ene nĩmagatuĩka ngombo cia ndũrĩrĩ nyingĩ na athamaki anene; na niĩ nĩngerĩhĩria harĩo kũringana na ciĩko ciao, o na kũringana na maũndũ marĩa maneeka na moko mao.”† Gĩkombe kĩa Marakara ma Ngai
english: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”

kikuyu: Akĩnyiita ndegwa igĩrĩ, agĩcitinangia icunjĩ, na agĩtũma andũ Isiraeli guothe nacio, makĩanagĩrĩra atĩrĩ, “Ũũ nĩguo ndegwa cia mũndũ o wothe igwĩkwo ũrĩa ũtekũrũmĩrĩra Saũlũ na Samũeli.” Naguo guoya woimĩte harĩ Jehova ũkĩnyiita andũ acio, nao makiumagara ta maarĩ o mũndũ ũmwe.
english: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of Yahweh fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

kikuyu: nĩguo ũhote kũnyiita thĩ na mĩthia yaguo, nao arĩa aaganu maribaribwo moime kuo?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, hakuhĩ na hau maarĩ, nĩ kwarĩ na gĩthaka kĩarĩ kĩa mũndũ wetagwo Pabulio, ũrĩa warĩ mũnene wa gĩcigĩrĩra kĩu. Nake nĩatũnyiitire ũgeni gwake, na kwa ihinda rĩa mĩthenya ĩtatũ agĩtũtuga wega arĩ na ũtaana.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

kikuyu: Mũkaamĩrĩĩra o kũu matũũra-inĩ manyu. No ĩrĩĩo nĩ arĩa marĩ na thaahu na arĩa matarĩ na thaahu, o taarĩ thiiya kana thwariga maraarĩa.
english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ inyuothe mũrũgamĩte ũmũthĩ mbere ya Jehova Ngai wanyu, na atongoria anyu, na atongoria a mĩhĩrĩga yanyu, na athuuri anyu, na anene anyu, na arũme arĩa angĩ othe a Isiraeli,
english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

kikuyu: Nĩkĩo ndaagũtinangirie icunjĩ na tũnua twa anabii akwa, ngĩkũũraga na ciugo cia kanua gakwa; matuĩro makwa magĩkĩhenũka ta rũheni igũrũ rĩaku.
english: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, mũtikanarĩe nyama irĩ na thakame, tondũ thakame nĩyo muoyo.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Elija akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Niĩ nyiki no niĩ ndigĩtwo ndĩ mũnabii wa Jehova, no Baali arĩ na anabii magana mana ma mĩrongo ĩtano.
english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Yahweh; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

kikuyu: Githĩ ũyũ ti Daudi ũrĩa mainĩire nyĩmbo-inĩ ciao ũũ: “ ‘Saũlũ nĩeyũragĩire andũ ngiri nyingĩ, nake Daudi akooraga ngiri makũmi maingĩ’?”
english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, rũciinĩ tene, athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa anene othe na athuuri a andũ makĩiguithania atĩ matuĩre Jesũ kũũragwo.
english: ow when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthondeka ngo nini magana matatũ cia thahabu hũũre; o ĩmwe yathondeketwo na ũritũ wa mina ithatũ§ cia thahabu. Mũthamaki agĩciiga Nyũmba ya Ũthamaki ĩrĩa yetagwo Mũtitũ wa Lebanoni.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas† of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ngũkwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩtoonya ũthamaki-inĩ wa Ngai atangĩciarwo na maaĩ na Roho.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtigĩra tũtikaagũthithio rwaro rwa ihiga, makĩrekia nanga inya kuuma mwena wa na thuutha wa marikabu, na makĩhooya gũkĩe.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

kikuyu: Tondũ nĩathikĩrĩirie-rĩ, ndĩrĩmũkayagĩra rĩrĩa rĩothe ngũtũũra muoyo.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, arĩria athuuri a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathani Jehova ekũũria atĩrĩ: Anga mũũkĩte gũtuĩria ũhoro harĩ niĩ? Ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa niĩ ndũũraga muoyo-rĩ, ndingĩreka mũtuĩrie ũhoro harĩ niĩ, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.’
english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will not be inquired of by you.” ’

kikuyu: Mbeeca icio ciarĩhaga aruti a wĩra arĩa maarutaga wĩra wa gũcookereria hekarũ.
english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired Yahweh’s house with it.

kikuyu: tondũ eeciiririe atĩrĩ, “Ingĩhutia nguo ciake, no hone.”
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Nĩ hinya ũigana atĩa ĩrĩ naguo njohero, na nĩ ũhoti mũnene atĩa ũrĩ mĩkiha-inĩ yayo ya nda!
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

kikuyu: Mĩguĩ yaku ĩrĩa mĩũgĩ nĩĩtheece thũ cia mũthamaki o ngoro-inĩ; ndũrĩrĩ nĩigwe magũrũ-inĩ maku.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ ikinya rĩa mũndũ kana rĩa nyamũ rĩgaatuĩkanĩria kuo; gũtirĩ mũndũ ũgaatũũra kuo ihinda rĩa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna.*
english: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũhaandaga waganu agethaga thĩĩna, naruo rũthanju rwa marakara make nĩrũkanangwo.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Kũu werũ-inĩ wa Moabi hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũrĩmo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jeriko, nĩkuo Jehova erĩire Musa atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: No ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, Elija nĩarĩkĩtie gũũka na andũ makamwĩka o ũrĩa wothe meendaga kũmwĩka, o ta ũrĩa ũhoro wake wandĩkĩtwo.” Kũhonio gwa Kamwana Kaarĩ na Ngoma Thũku
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

kikuyu: Aya nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Seiru ũrĩa Mũhori arĩa maatũũraga bũrũri ũcio: Lotani, na Shobali, na Zibeoni, na Ana,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Nĩwe ũgarũranagia mahinda na imera; nĩanenehagia athamaki, na akameheria ũthamaki-inĩ. Nĩwe ũheaga andũ arĩa oogĩ ũũgĩ, nao arĩa makũũranaga maũndũ akamahe ũmenyo.
english: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa abarũthi maatũmirwo kũrĩ we nĩ aathani a Babuloni mamũũrie ũhoro wa rũũri rwa kĩmenyithia rũrĩa ruonekete bũrũri-inĩ-rĩ, Ngai akĩmũtiganĩria nĩguo amũgerie amenye maũndũ marĩa mothe maarĩ ngoro-inĩ yake.
english: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

kikuyu: Indo cia itonga nĩ gĩtũũro kĩao kĩirigĩre na hinya, no ũkĩa nĩguo mwanangĩko wa andũ arĩa athĩĩni.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Ikĩria mũũmbi wa nyũngũ mbeeca icio”: ĩ thogora ũcio mwega moonire nĩũnjiganĩte! Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩoya icunjĩ icio mĩrongo ĩtatũ cia betha, ngĩciikĩria mũũmbi kũu nyũmba-inĩ ya Jehova.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ ndaarĩkia gũthiĩ, njũũi ndĩĩani nĩigooka gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu na itigacaaĩra rũũru rũrũ.
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa eerire maithe maitũ, atĩ nĩakaiguĩra Iburahĩmu hamwe na njiaro ciake tha, nginya tene.”
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring§ forever.”

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo mũgaakũũrania gĩcunjĩ kĩanyu gĩa ikũmi na betha, na inyuĩ mũtware betha ĩyo handũ harĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu agaathuura.
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Mika maarĩ: Pithoni, na Meleku, na Taharea, na Ahazu.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo o na Mũrũ wa Mũndũ ndookire gũtungatĩrwo, no ookire gũtungata na arute muoyo wake nĩguo arĩhe thogora wa gũkũũra andũ aingĩ.” Mũtumumu Baritimayo Kũhota Kuona
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: Nomũneneũciowambũtũciaitaagĩcookiaatĩrĩ, “Kaĩndatũmirwonĩmwathiwakwakũrĩmwathi wanyu na kũrĩ inyuĩ ndĩmwĩre maũndũ maya, na ti kũrĩ andũ aya maikarĩte rũthingo igũrũ, o aya makaarĩa kĩoro kĩao na manyue mathugumo mao o ene o ta ũrĩa inyuĩ mũgeeka?”
english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Musa aamwĩtĩkĩririe mũtiganage na atumia anyu tondũ wa ũmũ wa ngoro cianyu. No gũtiarĩ ũguo kuuma kĩambĩrĩria.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩona Akeni, na akĩaria ndũmĩrĩri yake, akiuga atĩrĩ: “Gĩikaro gĩaku nĩ kĩgitĩre, gĩtara gĩaku gĩakĩtwo thĩinĩ wa rwaro rwa ihiga;
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

kikuyu: Na mũndũ ũngĩ akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, niĩ nĩngũkũrũmĩrĩra, no reke nyambe thiĩ ngoigĩre andũ aitũ ũhoro.”
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

kikuyu: “Menyagĩrĩra wĩkage maũndũ marĩa mothe ngwĩrĩte. Ndũkanagwete marĩĩtwa ma ngai ingĩ; ndũkareke maiguuo makĩgwetwo na kanua gaku. Ciathĩ Ithatũ cia o Mwaka
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

kikuyu: na wa mũgwanja kũrĩ Hakozu, na wa kanana kũrĩ Abija,
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio mũhakũre akĩũria Filipu atĩrĩ, “Ndagũthaitha, ta njĩĩra atĩrĩ, mũnabii araaria ũhoro wa ũ, nĩ ũhoro wake we mwene kana nĩ ũhoro wa mũndũ ũngĩ?”
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

kikuyu: Githĩ ithuĩ tũtirĩ na kĩhooto kĩa mũndũ gũtwarana rũgendo-inĩ na mũtumia wake mwĩtĩkia, o ta ũrĩa atũmwo arĩa angĩ, na ariũ a nyina na Mwathani, o na Kefa mekaga?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

kikuyu: “Mũthamaki mwathi wakwa, andũ aya nĩmekĩte ũũru nĩ ũndũ wa maũndũ maya mothe mekĩte Jeremia ũrĩa mũnabii. Nĩmamũikĩtie irima rĩa maaĩ, akuĩre kuo nĩ ngʼaragu, tondũ mĩgate ĩkirie gũthira gũkũ itũũra-inĩ inene.”
english: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”

kikuyu: No nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte njĩkwo wega ũũ, atĩ nyina wa Mwathani wakwa no ooke kũnjeerera?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

kikuyu: Tũngiuga tũtirĩ na mehia, nĩ kwĩheenia tũkwĩheenia, naguo ũhoro wa ma ndũrĩ thĩinĩ witũ.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

kikuyu: Maikarĩte kwa ihinda-rĩ, Kaini akĩrehe maciaro mamwe ma mũgũnda marĩ igongona kũrĩ Jehova.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa agĩtwarĩra Jehova ũhoro ũcio wao,
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Rĩra, wee mũthithinda, nĩgũkorwo mũtarakwa nĩũgwĩte; mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩrũngarũ nĩmĩanange! Rĩrai inyuĩ mĩgandi ya Bashani; nĩgũkorwo mĩtĩ ya mũtitũ ũrĩa mũtumanu nĩĩtemetwo.
english: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.

kikuyu: Ngai-rĩ, akĩrĩ o Ngai wa Ayahudi oiki? Githĩ Ngai ti wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ o nao? Ĩĩ, nĩ Ngai wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ o nao,
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa tuo no mũrĩe mĩthemba yothe ya ngigĩ, na ndararĩki, na ngiria, o na kana ndaahi.
english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩarutire andũ arĩa abatari mathĩĩna-inĩ, na andũ a nyũmba ciao akĩmaingĩhia o ta mahiũ.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, githĩ ndũtũũraga kuuma tene o na tene? O Wee Ngai wakwa, ũrĩa wakwa mũtheru, tondũ ũcio tũtigakua. Wee Jehova-rĩ, nĩwe ũthuurĩte andũ a Babuloni mahingie ituĩro rĩaku; wee Rwaro rwa Ihiga-rĩ, ũkamaamũra matũherithie.
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God,§ my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Esaũ aiguire ciugo cia ithe, agĩtumũka na kĩrĩro kĩnene na kĩa ruo, akĩĩra ithe atĩrĩ, “Ndaathima! O na niĩ baba ndaathima!”
english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthamaki agĩĩta ago na aragũri, na arogi na arori a njata nĩguo moke mamwĩre ũrĩa aarootete. Rĩrĩa mookire makĩrũgama mbere ya mũthamaki,
english: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

kikuyu: Ariũ ao eerĩ, Ahimaazu mũrũ wa Zadoku, na Jonathani mũrũ wa Abiatharu marĩ kũu hamwe nao. Matũmage kũrĩ niĩ na ũndũ o wothe ũngĩigua.”
english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

kikuyu: nao makorwo marĩ aanake matarĩ kaũũgũ o na karĩkũ, na athaka makĩonwo, na andũ mekuoneka marĩ na ũtaũku maũndũ-inĩ mothe ma kwĩrutwo, na andũ mooĩ maũndũ wega, na ahũthũ kũnyiita maũndũ, na magĩrĩire gũtungata thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya ũthamaki. Ashipenazi aarĩ arute andũ acio rũthiomi na maandĩko ma Ababuloni.†
english: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: No angĩkorwo arĩ na kĩronda gĩtune kĩhara-inĩ kana thiithi-inĩ wake-rĩ, ũcio nĩ mũrimũ ũngĩgwatanio ũratuthũka kĩhara-inĩ kana thiithi-inĩ wake.
english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

kikuyu: Andũ makoorĩra ngurunga-inĩ cia ndwaro cia mahiga, o na marima-inĩ ma thĩ, moorĩre kĩmakania kĩa Jehova na riiri wa ũnene wake, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa akaarũgama athingithie thĩ.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova nĩekĩrĩte roho wa maheeni tũnua-inĩ twa anabii aya aku. Jehova nĩagwathĩrĩirie mwanangĩko.”
english: “Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

kikuyu: “Mwathani egũtũũra atũregete nginya tene? Ndarĩ hĩndĩ agacooka gũtũkenera?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano wa mweri ũcio nĩguo mũrĩgĩaga na gĩathĩ; mĩthenya mũgwanja mũrĩĩage mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, mwĩrutei na mũkũyũ: Rĩrĩa honge ciaguo ciarĩkia gũthundũra na ciaruta mathangũ- rĩ, nĩmũmenyaga atĩ hĩndĩ ya riũa ĩrĩ hakuhĩ.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

kikuyu: Na ningĩ-rĩ, njũkĩte gũtharĩkĩra na kwananga bũrũri ũyũ iterĩĩtwo nĩ Jehova? Jehova we mwene nĩwe wanjĩĩrire njũke hũũre bũrũri ũyũ na ndĩwanange.’ ”
english: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.” ’ ”

kikuyu: “ ‘Angĩkorwo mũndũ nĩakamũrĩra Jehova gĩcunjĩ kĩa mũgũnda wa nyũmba yao, thogora waguo ũgaatuuokũringananambeũiriaingĩhaandwo, nacionĩcekerimĩrongoĩtanociabetha, iriaarĩkĩbaba * 27:3 nĩ ta nuthu kilo (0.5) † 27:3 nĩ ta giramu ikũmi na ĩmwe na nuthu (11:5) ‡ 27:4 nĩ ta giramu 330 § 27:5 nĩ ta giramu 220 * 27:5 nĩ ta giramu 110 † 27:6 nĩ ta giramu 55 ‡ 27:6 nĩ ta giramu 33 § 27:7 nĩ ta giramu 165 * 27:7 nĩ ta giramu
english: “ ‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer‡ of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels§ of silver.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩwe ũrĩhaga o mũndũ nĩ ũndũ wa ũthingu wake, na wĩhokeku wake. Jehova nĩegũkũneanĩte moko-inĩ makwa ũmũthĩ, no niĩ ndingĩtambũrũkia guoko njũkĩrĩre ũrĩa mũitĩrĩrie maguta wa Jehova.
english: Yahweh will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.

kikuyu: Na thuutha wa ndungata kũmũkuua na kũmũtwarĩra nyina-rĩ, mwana ũcio agĩikara magũrũ-inĩ ma nyina nginya mĩaraho, agĩcooka agĩkua.
english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

kikuyu: Maitho ma Jehova nĩmamenyagĩrĩra ũmenyo, no nĩathaahagia ciugo cia ũrĩa ũtarĩ mwĩhokeku.
english: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

kikuyu: no rĩrĩ, mũndũ nĩkũgerio ageragio hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ekũguucĩrĩrio na akaheenererio nĩ merirĩria make mooru.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ndĩrona atĩ ithuĩ atũmwo Ngai atũigĩte handũ tũrĩonekaga tũrĩ thuutha wa andũ arĩa angĩ othe, na ta andũ matuĩrĩirwo kũũragĩrwo thĩinĩ wa kĩhaaro kĩa mathako. Nĩtũtuĩtwo kĩndũ gĩa kwĩrorerwo nĩ thĩ yothe, kũrĩ araika o na kũrĩ andũ.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Jehosheba, mwarĩ wa Mũthamaki Jehoramu, akĩoya Joashu mũrũ wa Ahazia akĩmũruta na hitho kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a mũthamaki arĩa maakirie kũũragwo, na akĩmũhitha nyũmba ya toro hamwe na mũreri wake. Tondũ Jehosheba, mwarĩ wa Mũthamaki Jehoramu na ningĩ mũtumia wa Jehoiada ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, aarĩ mwarĩ wa nyina na Ahazia, nĩahithire mwana ũcio
english: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa rũhuho rumĩte mwena wa gũthini rwambĩrĩirie kũhurutana kahora-rĩ, magĩĩciiria nĩmona kĩrĩa mendaga, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩohora marikabu magĩthiĩ magereire hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Kirete.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

kikuyu: Nakĩo gĩkonde gĩkĩ gĩakwa kĩarĩkia gũthira, na mwĩrĩ ũyũ wa nyama ũkorwo ũtarĩ ho, hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩ ngoona Ngai;
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

kikuyu: “Niĩ Danieli nĩndatangĩkire roho-inĩ, nacio cioneki iria ciahĩtũkĩire meciiria-inĩ makwa igĩĩthĩĩnia mũno.
english: “As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngeheria andũ a Isiraeli bũrũri ũyũ ndĩmaheete na ndiganĩrie hekarũ ĩno nyamũrĩte ĩĩtanio na Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa. Bũrũri wa Isiraeli ũgaatuĩka wa kuunagwo thimo, na kĩndũ gĩa gũthekererwo nĩ andũ othe.
english: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ-rĩ, nũũ Mũrungu tiga Jehova? Na nũũ Rwaro rwa Ihiga tiga Ngai witũ?
english: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?

kikuyu: Maũndũ macio magaatuĩka ithaga rĩa kũgemia mũtwe waku, na ta mũgathĩ wa kũgemia ngingo yaku.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, inyuĩ mũrahĩtũka, anga mũkuona ũndũ ũyũ ta ũtamũkoniĩ? Ta rorai muone. Nĩ kũrĩ thĩĩna ũiganaine na thĩĩna ũyũ wakwa, thĩĩna ũrĩa njigĩrĩirwo, o ũcio Jehova aandehithĩirie mũthenya wa marakara make mahiũ?
english: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

kikuyu: Andũ nĩ kũũra mooraga maigua mũrurumo wa mũgambo waku; warahũka-rĩ, ndũrĩrĩ nĩihurunjũkaga.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩtũmĩra Jehoshafatu mũthamaki wa Juda ndũmĩrĩri ĩno: “Mũthamaki wa Moabi nĩanjũkĩrĩire akanemera. Nĩũgũthiĩ na niĩ tũkahũũrane na Moabi?” Nake akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ĩĩ, nĩngũthiĩ nawe, niĩ nawe tũrĩ ũndũ ũmwe, andũ akwa no ta andũ aku, na mbarathi ciakwa no ta mbarathi ciaku.”
english: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Rĩrĩa mũndũ-wa-nja angiura thakame ategũtigithĩria mĩthenya mĩingĩ ihinda rĩtarĩ rĩake rĩa mweri, kana kuura kũngĩ gũkĩrĩte ihinda rĩake rĩa mweri, nĩagaikara arĩ na thaahu rĩrĩa rĩothe ekuura ũguo, o ta ũrĩa akoragwo arĩ na thaahu ihinda-inĩ rĩake rĩa mweri.
english: “ ‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ Mũngũũri arĩ muoyo, na atĩ marigĩrĩrio-inĩ nĩwe ũkaarũgama thĩ ĩno.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

kikuyu: Ũkaamarehe thĩinĩ na ũmahaande kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa igai rĩaku, o handũ harĩa, Wee Jehova,
english: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

kikuyu: Arĩa maarĩ ahũũnu meyandĩkithagia nĩguo mone irio, no arĩa maarĩ ahũtu nĩmathirĩtwo nĩ ngʼaragu. Thaata nĩĩciarĩte ciana mũgwanja, no ũrĩa warĩ na aanake aingĩ nĩmũhinyĩrĩrĩku.
english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

kikuyu: Eĩĩraga na ngoro yake atĩrĩ, “Gũtirĩ ũndũ ũngĩnyinainia; ndĩrĩkoragwo ndĩ mũkenu hĩndĩ ciothe na gũtirĩ hĩndĩ ngoona thĩĩna.”
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jusufu ookire mũciĩ-rĩ, makĩmũhe iheo iria maarehete kũu nyũmba-inĩ, na makĩinamĩrĩra, magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ mbere yake.
english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

kikuyu: na Gazamu, na Uza, na Pasea,
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

kikuyu: Nake Daudi agĩkuhĩrĩria, na rĩrĩa Arauna aarorire akĩmuona, akiuma kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano, akĩinamĩrĩria mũtwe wake mbere ya Daudi, na agĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: Nao andũ acio makĩguthũkĩra Jesũ makĩmũnyiita.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩhakũraga mũhu wa moori ĩyo, no nginya athambie nguo ciake, o nake atiinde arĩ na thaahu nginya hwaĩ-inĩ. Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ watho wa gũtũũra harĩ andũ a Isiraeli na ageni arĩa matũũranagia nao.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

kikuyu: No tondũ wa tha ciaku nyingĩ, ndwamaniinire kana ũkĩmatiganĩria, nĩgũkorwo ũrĩ Mũrungu mũtugi na mũigua tha.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

kikuyu: Nĩndĩmũheete bũrũri wa Misiri ũtuĩke kĩheo gĩa kĩyo gĩake, tondũ we na mbũtũ ciake cia ita meekire ũguo nĩ ũndũ wakwa, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Menya na ma atĩ njiaro ciaku nĩigatũũra irĩ ageni bũrũri ũtarĩ wacio, na nĩigatuuo ngombo na inyariirwo mĩaka magana mana.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa ndogo yũmbũragwo nĩ rũhuho-rĩ, ũromombũra; o ta ũrĩa mũhũra ũringũkagio nĩ mwaki-rĩ, andũ arĩa aaganu marothira marĩ mbere ya Ngai.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Mũlawii ũcio mũthuuri wa mũtumia ũrĩa woragĩtwo akiuga atĩrĩ, “Niĩ na thuriya yakwa tuokire Gibea ya andũ a Benjamini tũraarĩrĩre kuo.
english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

kikuyu: marĩa mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũragĩte mũndũ angĩorĩire angĩkorwo oragĩte mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake atathugundĩte, na atarĩ na rũthũũro. Nĩangĩorĩire itũũra rĩmwe rĩa macio ahonokie muoyo wake.
english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

kikuyu: nĩ ũndũ wa mĩgate ĩrĩa ĩigagwo metha-inĩ; nĩ ũndũ wa mahinda ma maruta ma mũtu na ma njino; na nĩ ũndũ wa maruta marĩa marutagwo mũthenya wa Thabatũ, na wa ciathĩ cia Karũgamo ka Mweri, na wa ciathĩ iria ciathanĩtwo; nĩ ũndũ wa maruta marĩa maamũre; nĩ ũndũ wa maruta ma kũhoroheria mehia ma Isiraeli; o na nĩ ũndũ wa mawĩra mothe ma nyũmba ya Ngai witũ.
english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

kikuyu: Anene atatũ a acio mĩrongo ĩtatũ, nĩmaikũrũkire magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Daudi ihiga-inĩ rĩrĩa rĩarĩ ngurunga-inĩ ya Adulamu, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mbũtũ ya Afilisti yaambĩte hema Kĩanda kĩa Refaimu.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũkaagĩa kĩrĩĩko na mũndũ-wa-nja gĩa kũmũhikia, no mũndũ ũngĩ nĩakamuoya akome nake. Nĩũgaka nyũmba no ndũkamĩtũũra. Nĩũkahaanda mũgũnda wa mĩthabibũ no ndũkambĩrĩria gũkenera maciaro mayo.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

kikuyu: Nao andũ acio nĩmamakire maatwarwo gwake mũciĩ. Magĩĩciiria atĩrĩ, “Twarehwo gũkũ nĩ ũndũ wa betha iria ciacookirio makũnia-inĩ maitũ hĩndĩ ya mbere. Arenda gũtũtharĩkĩra atũtoorie na atũtue ngombo ciake, na oe ndigiri ciitũ.”
english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

kikuyu: Kanitha nĩguo mwĩrĩ wake, na noguo ũiyũru wake, o we ũiyũrĩte maũndũ mothe o na kũndũ guothe.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

kikuyu: Mĩnyamaro-inĩ yakwa ndakaĩire Jehova; ngĩgĩkaĩra Ngai wakwa arĩ hekarũ-inĩ yake. Nĩ aiguire mũgambo wakwa, kĩrĩro gĩakwa gĩgĩkinya matũ-inĩ make.
english: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩamũra Kedeshi itũũra rĩrĩa rĩrĩ kũu Galili bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Nafitali, na Shekemu itũũra rĩa bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Efiraimu, na Kiriathu-Ariba (na nĩkuo Hebironi) itũũra rĩa bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Juda.
english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

kikuyu: O na kũrĩ ũguo, ũmũthĩ na rũciũ o na oke no nginya ngorwo ngĩthiĩ o na mbere, nĩgũkorwo ti-itherũ gũtirĩ mũnabii ũngĩkuĩra nja ya Jerusalemu!
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

kikuyu: Ndeciiragia atĩrĩ, ‘Ũkũrũ nĩwaagĩrĩire warie; ũingĩ wa mĩaka nĩwaagĩrĩire kũrutana ũũgĩ.’
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

kikuyu: No Paũlũ akĩanĩrĩra, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndũkeegere ngero! Ithuothe tũrĩ ho!”
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa ndeciiragia ũhoro wa hĩa icio-rĩ, ngĩona hau mbere yakwa harĩ na rũhĩa rũngĩ, na rwarĩ rũnini, rũkĩmera gatagatĩ ka icio ingĩ; nacio hĩa ithatũ cia iria ciarĩ cia mbere ikĩmunyũka biũ, ikĩrweherera. Naruo rũhĩa rũu rwarĩ na maitho ta ma mũndũ na kanua kaaragia ndeto cia mwĩtĩĩo.
english: “I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking arrogantly.

kikuyu: Nĩngamũminjaminjĩria maaĩ matheru, na inyuĩ nĩmũgathera; nĩ niĩ ngaamũtheria mũthirwo nĩ thaahu wanyu wothe, na ndĩmũtherie kuuma kũrĩ mĩhianano yanyu yothe.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ andũ magĩũkĩra rũciinĩ tene, makĩruta magongona ma njino na ma ũiguano. Thuutha ũcio magĩikara thĩ kũrĩa na kũnyua, magĩcooka magĩũkĩra kũina na gwĩkenia.
english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

kikuyu: “Aaruta ndigithũ yake kĩande o naihenya anjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Nyua, na nĩngũnyuithia o na ngamĩĩra ciaku.’ Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndanyua maaĩ na ahe ngamĩĩra o nacio.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

kikuyu: Githĩ to rĩu wanjĩta ũkiugaga: ‘Baba, wee mũrata wakwa kuuma ndĩ o mũnini,
english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, maitho makwa nĩwe macũthĩrĩirie, Wee Mwathani Jehova; nĩ harĩwe njũragĩra; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndũkareke ngue.
english: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

kikuyu: Jehova agĩtũma andũ ake maciarane mũno; agĩtũma maingĩhe mũno gũkĩra thũ ciao,
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Ishumaeli igĩtũũra kuuma Havila nginya Shuri, gũkuhĩ na mũhaka wa Misiri werekeire bũrũri wa Ashuri. Nao magĩtũũra na rũmena na ariũ arĩa angĩ othe a ithe wao. Jakubu na Esaũ
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

kikuyu: “Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmagathiĩ kũrĩa andũ maherithagio tene na tene, no arĩa athingu mathiĩ muoyo-inĩ wa tene na tene.”
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩ niĩ kĩhingo; ũrĩa wothe ũtoonyagĩra harĩ niĩ nĩakahonoka. Agaatoonyaga na akoima, na onage gĩa kũrĩa.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo mũrũ kana mwarĩ wa thoguo nĩekũigua ũũru tondũ wa kĩrĩa ũrĩĩaga-rĩ, wee nĩũtigĩte gũthiĩ na mĩthiĩre ya wendani. Tiga gũtũma mũrũ kana mwarĩ wa Ithe wanyu ũcio Kristũ aakuĩrĩire oore nĩ ũndũ wa kĩrĩa ũrarĩa.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

kikuyu: Ndaigua ũguo ngoro yakwa ĩgatumatuuma, na ĩkambarara ĩkoima handũ hayo.
english: Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩwe mũndũ wa riika rĩakwa, mũthiritũ wakwa, mũrata wakwa ũrĩa twendanĩte mũno,
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

kikuyu: nĩmoranagia atĩrĩ, “Nũũ ũgũtũgaragarĩria ihiga rĩehere mũromo-inĩ wa mbĩrĩra?”
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

kikuyu: Thiaka wa mũmĩhaici ũbocabocaga mbaru-inĩ ciayo, hamwe na itimũ rĩkũhenia na mĩcengi.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũu tũgĩthiĩ Filipi, kũrĩa gwathagwo nĩ andũ a Roma, na nĩrĩo rĩarĩ itũũra rĩrĩa inene rĩa bũrũri ũcio wa Makedonia. Na tũgĩikara kũu mĩthenya ĩtaarĩ mĩingĩ.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, kuuma gĩthukĩ-inĩ kĩa Jesii nĩhakoima mũndũ ũhaana ta thuuna ĩrathundũka, na Rũhonge rũrĩa rũkoima mĩri-inĩ yake nĩrũgaciara maciaro.
english: shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

kikuyu: Tonyerai ihingo ciake mũrĩ na ngaatho, mũtoonye nja ciake mũkĩmũgoocaga; mũcookeriei ngaatho na mũgooce rĩĩtwa rĩake.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

kikuyu: aarĩ korwo mũtwe wakwa nĩ itherũkĩro rĩa maaĩ, namo maitho makwa nĩ gĩthima kĩa maithori! Ingĩrĩraga mũthenya na ũtukũ, ngĩrĩrĩra andũ akwa arĩa moragĩtwo.
english: h that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

kikuyu: Nĩ gũkorwo igai rĩa Jehova nĩ andũ ake, Jakubu nĩwe igai rĩake rĩrĩa eegaĩire.
english: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩrĩa niĩ ndaaragia ngĩhooyaga na ngiumbũraga mehia makwa na ma andũ akwa a Isiraeli, na ngĩthaitha Jehova Ngai wakwa nĩ ũndũ wa kĩrĩma gĩake gĩtheru,
english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God—

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo harĩ niĩ-rĩ, gũtũũra muoyo nĩ Kristũ, nakuo gũkua-rĩ, nĩ uumithio.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

kikuyu: ee Jehova, igua ihooya rĩakwa; reke gũkaya gwakwa ngĩhooya ũteithio gũgũkinyĩre.
english: ear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

kikuyu: na Ibineia mũrũ wa Jerohamu; Ela mũrũ wa Uzi, mũrũ wa Mikiri; na Meshulamu mũrũ wa Shefatia, mũrũ wa Reueli, mũrũ wa Ibinija.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

kikuyu: na metha na indo ciayo ciothe, na mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa na indo ciaguo, na kĩgongona gĩa gũcinĩra ũbumba, na
english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

kikuyu: na kuuma njiaro cia Pahathu-Moabi, aarĩ Eliehoenai mũrũ wa Zerahia, hamwe na andũ angĩ 200;
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

kikuyu: “Andũ mangĩũgitana na ũmwe aringe ũrĩa ũngĩ na ihiga kana na ngundi na aage gũkua, no akome ũrĩrĩ kwa ihinda-rĩ,
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

kikuyu: Nake Musa agĩĩtĩkĩra gũikara kwa mũndũ ũcio, nake akĩmũhe mwarĩ wetagwo Zipora amũhikie.
english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa aiguire atĩ nĩ Jesũ wa Nazarethi, akĩambĩrĩria kwanĩrĩra akiugaga atĩrĩ, “Jesũ, Mũrũ wa Daudi, njiguĩra tha!”
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Ariũ a Rubeni maarĩ: Hanoku, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: “Mũhehenjaga andũ akwa, na mũkamemenda mothiũ ma athĩĩni nĩkĩ?” nĩguo Mwathani Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ekũũria.
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

kikuyu: “ ‘Rĩrĩa mũkũhaarĩria gategwa nĩ ũndũ wa iruta rĩa njino kana igongona, nĩ ũndũ wa mwĩhĩtwa wa mwanya kana iruta rĩa ũiguano rĩrutĩirwo Jehova-rĩ,
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,

kikuyu: “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmaga wone kĩhuti kĩrĩa kĩrĩ riitho rĩa mũrũ wa thoguo, no ũkaaga kuona mũgogo ũrĩa ũrĩ riitho rĩaku wee mwene?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Nĩngarehithĩria andũ a Elamu huho iria inya ciumaga mĩena ĩrĩa ĩna ya igũrũ; ngaamahurunjĩra na kũu huho icio inya ciumaga, na gũtirĩ rũrĩrĩ o na rũmwe andũ acio aingate a Elamu matakoorĩra.
english: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.

kikuyu: Ũngĩruta ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ maũndũ maya-rĩ, nĩũgũtuĩka ndungata njega ya Kristũ Jesũ, ĩrĩa ĩreretwonaciugociaũhoro-ũrĩa-wa-mawawĩtĩkioonaciaũrutanimwegaũrĩaweeũtũireũrũmĩrĩire.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

kikuyu: Nayo ndungata ĩyo ĩkĩhiũha ĩkamũtũnge, na ĩkĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndagũthaitha, he tũũĩ tũnini twa kũnyua kuuma ndigithũ-inĩ yaku.”
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, mũndũ ũrĩa ũkũregana na ũrutani ũyũ ti mũndũ araregana nake no nĩ Ngai, ũrĩa ũmũheaga inyuĩ Roho wake Mũtheru.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo roho ũcio ũkagĩĩra maroho mangĩ mũgwanja mooru makĩria maguo mwene, magatoonya magaikara kũu. Naguo mũikarĩre wa mũndũ ũcio ũgathũka gũkĩra wa mbere. Ũguo nĩguo gũkahaana kũrĩ rũciaro rũrũ rwaganu.”
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

kikuyu: Wee Ngai-rĩ, nyũmbĩra ngoro theru thĩinĩ wakwa, na ũnjerũhĩrie roho wa kwĩhokeka thĩinĩ wakwa.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩkaania andũ a Isiraeli na andũ a Juda na ũndũ wa anabii ake othe na andũ arĩa moonaga maũndũ, akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Garũrũkai mũtigane na njĩra cianyu cia
english: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa aaganu nĩmanyambĩire mũtego, no ndirĩ ndahĩtia kĩrĩra gĩaku.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your

kikuyu: We ũcio Rũgai rwa Jakubu ndatariĩ tayo, nĩgũkorwo nĩwe Mũũmbi wa indo ciothe, o hamwe na Isiraeli mũhĩrĩga ũrĩa, eegwatĩire ũtuĩke igai rĩake, Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, nĩrĩo rĩĩtwa rĩake. Mwanangĩko ũrĩa Ũroka
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: Ningĩ niĩ nĩngacooka gwakwa, nginya rĩrĩa magetĩkĩra mahĩtia mao. Nao nĩmakarongooria ũthiũ wakwa; nao mona mathĩĩna nĩmakanongoria na kĩo.”
english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”

kikuyu: andũ acio eerĩ magĩte na ngarari, no nginya marũgame harĩ Jehova, mbere ya athĩnjĩri-Ngai na aciirithania arĩa magaakorwo makĩruta wĩra ihinda-inĩ rĩu.
english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli moonire atĩ maarĩ handũ hooru mũno, na ita rĩao nĩrĩahatĩrĩirio mũno, makĩĩhitha ngurunga-inĩ na ihinga-inĩ, na gatagatĩ ka ndwaro cia mahiga, na thĩinĩ wa marima, o na marima-inĩ ma maaĩ.
english: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

kikuyu: Na thuutha wa gũtuĩka ithe wa Tera, Nahoru agĩtũũra muoyo mĩaka ĩngĩ igana na ikũmi na kenda, na akĩgĩa na ciana ingĩ cia aanake na cia airĩtu.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Nake Delila agĩtũma Samusoni akome ciero-inĩ ciake, agĩĩta mũndũ ũmwe amwenje makundo mothe mũgwanja ma njuĩrĩ yake, nao makĩambĩrĩria kũmũtooria. Naguo hinya wake ũkĩmuuma.
english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

kikuyu: “Efiraimu ahaana ta ndutura, ĩrĩa ĩheenekaga narua, ĩtarĩ ũmenyo; rĩmwe akayagĩra bũrũri wa Misiri na rĩrĩa rĩngĩ agathiĩ Ashuri.
english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

kikuyu: Jehova Ngai wanyu nĩamũingĩhĩtie mũno nginya ũmũthĩ mũrĩ aingĩ o ta njata cia igũrũ.
english: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: 115 Alawii 10:20 10 Gĩkuũ kĩa Nadabu na Abihu 1 Na rĩrĩ, ariũ a Harũni, nĩo Nadabu na Abihu, nĩmoire ngĩo ciao cia ũbani, magĩciĩkĩra mwaki na makĩongerera ũbani; na makĩrehe mwaki ũteetĩkĩrĩtio mbere ya Jehova, ũrĩa wareganĩte na watho wa Jehova.
english: adab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.

kikuyu: Ngano no nginya ĩthĩo nĩguo ĩthondekwo mũgate; nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũndũ ndatũũraga amĩhũũraga nginya tene. O na angĩtwarĩra magũrũ ma ngaari ya kũhũũra igũrũ rĩayo-rĩ, mbarathi ciake itingĩmĩthĩa.
english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka nĩakaanĩtie Solomoni kũrũmĩrĩra ngai ingĩ-rĩ, Solomoni ndaigana kũrũmia watho wa Jehova.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

kikuyu: Mũrũguo agaatuĩka wa mbũrũrũ ta ndigiri ya gĩthaka; guoko gwake gũgookagĩrĩra andũ othe, nao andũ othe mamũũkagĩrĩre: agaatũũra na ũthũ na ariũ a ithe othe.”
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

kikuyu: Mangĩmwathĩkĩra na mamũtungatĩre, megũtũũra matukũ mao marĩa matigaru magaacĩire, na mĩaka yao o maiganĩire.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Johana ookire atekũrĩa na atekũnyua, nao andũ makiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Arĩ na ndaimono.’
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: ningĩ kuona atĩ ndaiguĩrĩire thĩ ya tene tha hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aarehire kĩguũ kĩa maaĩ kũrĩ andũ arĩa maatũũraga kuo matetĩkĩtie Ngai, no akĩgitĩra Nuhu, ũrĩa warĩ mũhunjia wa ũthingu na andũ angĩ mũgwanja;
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

kikuyu: ngĩrega Esaũ, bũrũri wake wa irĩma ngĩwananga ũgĩtuĩka tũhũ, narĩo igai rĩake ngĩrĩtua werũ wa gũikaragwo nĩ mbwe.”
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

kikuyu: Kũrua gũtirĩ bata; o na kwaga kũrua gũtirĩ bata. Ũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩ bata nĩ kũmenyerera maathani ma Ngai.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩũũhonoketie kuuma gĩkuũ-inĩ, na ũkagirĩrĩria magũrũ makwa kũhĩngwo, nĩguo thiiage mbere ya Ngai
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living. 57 For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

kikuyu: kana andũ moige atĩrĩ, ‘Ũrĩ haha,’ kana ‘Ũrĩ harĩa,’ tondũ ũthamaki wa Ngai ũrĩ thĩinĩ wanyu.”
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

kikuyu: ũguo nĩ kuuga ũthamaki wothe wa Ogu kũu Bashani, ũrĩa waathanaga Ashitarothu na Edirei, nake ũcio nĩwe warĩ wa mũico wa matigari ma Arefaimu. Musa nĩamatooretie na agataha bũrũri wao.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

kikuyu: Na mwaka wa mĩrongo ĩna na ũmwe wa wathani wake, Asa agĩkua na akĩhurũka hamwe na maithe make.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

kikuyu: “Mũtigathikĩrĩrie Hezekia. Mũthamaki wa Ashuri ekuuga ũũ: Rekei tũiguane, na mũũke kũrĩ niĩ. Mweka ũguo o ũmwe wanyu nĩakarĩĩaga kuuma kũrĩ mũtĩ wake wa mũthabibũ na mũkũyũ, na anyuuage maaĩ ma gĩthima gĩake,
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

kikuyu: nĩguo ahaarĩrie andũ a Ngai nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wa gũtungata, nĩgeetha mwĩrĩ wa Kristũ wongererwo hinya,
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

kikuyu: Daudi we mwene nĩoigĩte ibuku-inĩ rĩa Thaburi atĩrĩ: “ ‘Mwathani nĩerire Mwathani wakwa atĩrĩ: “Ikara guoko-inĩ gwakwa kwa ũrĩo,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

kikuyu: Nĩngwamba kũrũgamia mangʼũrĩ makwa nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa; na tondũ wa ũgooci wakwa ndigĩrĩirie mangʼũrĩ macio matigagũkore, nĩguo ndigakũniine biũ.
english: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.

kikuyu: Marĩ na muoroto ũmwe, na nĩmakaheana ũhoti na wathani wao kũrĩ nyamũ ĩyo.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

kikuyu: Ndiĩhokaga ũta wakwa, rũhiũ rwakwa rwa njora ti ruo rũngĩĩhootanĩra;
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

kikuyu: Reke matuĩke a gũtuithania andũ aya ciira mahinda mothe, no makũrehagĩre maciira marĩa maritũ; marĩa mahũthũ makamatuithanagia arĩ o. Ũndũ ũcio nĩũgũkũhũthĩria mũrigo, tondũ nĩmarĩgayanaga nawe.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, nĩũkũrĩtuĩra ciira? Nĩũgũ- tuĩra ciira itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene rĩitithagia thakame? Nĩ ũndũ ũcio rĩonie maũndũ marĩa mothe rĩĩkaga marĩ magigi,
english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.

kikuyu: Jehova Mwene- Hinya-Wothe ekuuga ũũ: “Mahinda ma kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio mweri wa kana, na wa gatano, na wa mũgwanja na wa ikũmi-rĩ, magaatuĩka mahinda ma gũcanjamũka na kũrũũhia, na ma maruga ma gĩkeno harĩ Juda. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio endagai ũhoro wa ma na wa thayũ.”
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

kikuyu: Tũma mamenye atĩ kũu nĩ guoko gwaku, mamenye atĩ Wee Jehova, nĩwe wĩkĩte ũguo.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

kikuyu: Jakubu nĩeerĩte Rakeli atĩ nĩ metainwo na ithe, na atĩ aarĩ mũrũ wa Rebeka. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Rakeli agĩtengʼera akĩĩra ithe ũhoro ũcio.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was

kikuyu: Nake akĩoya mĩgate ĩyo ĩtano na thamaki icio igĩrĩ, akĩrora na igũrũ, agĩcookia ngaatho na akĩenyũranga mĩgate ĩyo. Agĩcooka akĩmĩnengera arutwo ake mahe andũ. Ningĩ akĩoya thamaki icio igĩrĩ akĩmagayania othe.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Ngai nĩatũhonoketie, agatũruta ũthamaki-inĩ wa nduma, na agatũthaamĩria ũthamaki-inĩ wa Mũriũ ũrĩa endete mũno,
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

kikuyu: na akĩmũhooya marũa athiĩ namo thunagogi-inĩ iria ciarĩ Dameski, nĩgeetha angĩkora andũ a Njĩra ĩyo kuo, marĩ arũme kana andũ-a-nja, amanyiite amatware Jerusalemu marĩ ohe.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found  Isaiah 53:7,8  TR adds Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.” He answered, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Na makĩrehe Hashabia hamwe na Jeshaia wa kuuma njiaro cia Merari, na ariũ a ithe na ciana ciao, othe andũ
english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

kikuyu: Ariũ a Zera maarĩ: Zimuri, na Ethani, na Hemani, na Kalikoli, na Darida; othe maarĩ atano.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa othe tũrĩ nao nĩmamũgeithia. Geithia andũ arĩa othe matwendete thĩinĩ wa wĩtĩkio. Wega wa Ngai ũrogĩa na inyuĩ inyuothe.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Ngoretwo ngĩthiĩ ngʼendo nyingĩ. Ngagĩkorwo ndĩ ũgwati-inĩ wa gũtwarwo nĩ njũũĩ, na ũgwati-inĩ wa atunyani, na ũgwati-inĩ wa gũũkĩrĩrwo nĩ andũ a rũrĩrĩ rwitũ, na ũgwati-inĩ wa gũũkĩrĩrwo nĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ; na ngoona ũgwati ndĩ matũũra-inĩ manene, na ndĩ thĩinĩ wa bũrũri, na ndĩ iria-inĩ; o na ũgwati wa andũ arĩa maheenanagia atĩ nĩ ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ.
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũtikanehĩte na maheeni mũkĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthaahie rĩĩtwa rĩa Ngai wanyu. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: “ ‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mũgambo wa Jehova nĩũgathethera Ashuri; nĩakamagũtha na rũthanju rwake, amaniine magũe.
english: For through Yahweh’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ndaigana kũũraga ariũ a oragani acio, kũringana na ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo Ibuku-inĩ rĩa Watho wa Musa harĩa Jehova aathanĩte atĩrĩ: “Maithe ma ciana matikooragwo nĩ ũndũ wa ciana, o na kana ciana ciũragwo nĩ ũndũ wa maithe mao; o mũndũ arĩkuaga nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make mwene.”
english: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

kikuyu: “Gĩai na hinya na mũũmĩrĩrie. Mũtigetigĩre, kana mũkue ngoro nĩ ũndũ wa mũthamaki wa Ashuri na mbũtũ nene ya ita ĩrĩa arĩ nayo, nĩgũkorwo tũrĩ na hinya mũnene mũno gũkĩra ũrĩa arĩ naguo.
english: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.

kikuyu: Nĩũkanyiitwo nĩ kĩrumi rĩinũkĩro-inĩ rĩa gwaku mũciĩ, na ũnyiitwo nĩ kĩrumi ũkiumagara.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Galio aarĩ barũthi wa Akaia, Ayahudi makĩnyiitana magĩtharĩkĩra Paũlũ na makĩmũtwara igooti-inĩ.
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia-rĩ, mũmaraya ũrĩa wetagwo Rahabu, tondũ wa kũnyiita athigaani ũgeni, ndoraganĩirio na andũ arĩa maarĩ aremi.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

kikuyu: Matanathiĩ kũraya na itũũra rĩu inene-rĩ, Jusufu akĩĩra mũnene wa nyũmba yake atĩrĩ, “Rũmĩrĩra andũ acio o rĩu, na wamakinyĩra ũmoorie atĩrĩ, ‘Mwarĩha wega na ũũru nĩkĩ?
english: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

kikuyu: Thuutha wa ciumia mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na igĩrĩ, ũcio Mũitĩrĩrie Maguta nĩakooragwo na atigwo atarĩ na kĩndũ. Ningĩ andũ a mũtongoria ũrĩa ũgooka thuutha wake nĩmagathũkangia itũũra rĩu inene o na handũ-harĩa-haamũre. Ithirĩro rĩgooka ta mũiyũro wa maaĩ: Nayo mbaara ĩgaathiĩ na mbere o nginya ithirĩro, na nĩgũtuĩtwo atĩ nĩgũgacooka gũkire ihooru.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One§ will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.

kikuyu: “ ‘Maya nĩmo maarĩ mehia ma mwarĩ wa nyũkwa Sodomu: We marĩ na airĩtu ake maarĩ andũ etĩĩi, a kwĩhũũnĩrĩria, na matiarũmbũyagia ũhoro wa andũ arĩa angĩ; matiateithirie andũ arĩa athĩĩni o na arĩa abatari.
english: “ ‘ “Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

kikuyu: Matũũra macio mothe ikũmi hamwe na ithaka ciamo cia ũrĩithio nĩmo maheirwo mbarĩ icio ingĩ cia Kohathu.
english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: O hĩndĩ ĩyo aragia, hagĩũka gĩkundi kĩa andũ, nake mũndũ ũrĩa wetagwo Judasi, ũmwe wa arutwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ, nĩwe wamatongoretie. Agĩkuhĩrĩria Jesũ amũmumunye,
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

kikuyu: O ũndũ ũmwe nĩathondekire buremu irĩ na mĩena ĩna cia mĩtamaiyũ cia itoonyero rĩa nyũmba ĩrĩa nene.
english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

kikuyu: Nao makĩambata makahũũrane na andũ a Benjamini mũthenya wa gatatũ na makĩrũgama handũ hao nĩguo mahũũrane na Gibea o ta ũrĩa meekĩte hau mbere.
english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa ũgaacambia Mũrũ wa Mũndũ nĩakarekerwo, no ũrĩa wothe ũkaruma Roho Mũtheru ndakarekerwo.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio tiga kũmũrora, tigana nake, nginya arĩĩkie mĩthenya yake ta mũthũkũmi.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

kikuyu: Harĩa mĩaka ĩyo 430 yathirĩire-rĩ, mũthenya o ro ũcio, nĩguo ikundi ciothe cia andũ a Jehova cioimire bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: No wee ũngĩkaania mũndũ ũcio mwaganu, nake arege kũgarũrũka atigane na waganu wake kana mĩthiĩre yake mĩũru-rĩ, we nĩagaakua nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make; no wee-rĩ, nĩũgaakorwo ũhonoketie muoyo waku.
english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

kikuyu: No nyende kũmenya ũndũ ũmwe tu kuuma kũrĩ inyuĩ: Mwaheirwo Roho nĩ ũndũ wa gwathĩkĩra watho, kana nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia ũhoro ũrĩa mwaiguire?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa aatoonyaga gatũũra kamwe, agĩtũngwo nĩ andũ ikũmi maarĩ na mũrimũ wa mangũ. Makĩrũgama o haraaya,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

kikuyu: Mũthenya o ro ũcio, Musa agĩatha andũ acio, akĩmeera atĩrĩ:
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

kikuyu: Fesito aigua ũguo, akĩmũgũthũkĩra akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee Paũlũ nĩkũgũrũka ũgũrũkĩte! Gĩthomo kĩu gĩaku kĩingĩ nĩgĩtũmĩte ũgũrũke.”
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

kikuyu: tondũ wa mangʼũrĩ maku manene, ũnjoete na igũrũ ũkanjikia mwena-inĩ.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

kikuyu: Atongoria a Juda mahaana andũ arĩa meheragia mahiga ma mĩhaka. Nĩngamaitĩrĩria mangʼũrĩ makwa, taarĩ kĩguũ kĩa maaĩ.
english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Reke gũtuĩke ũguo rĩu; tondũ nĩtwagĩrĩirwo twĩke ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo tũhingie maũndũ mothe ma ũthingu.” Hĩndĩ ĩyo Johana agĩĩtĩkĩra. * 3:7 Afarisai na Asadukai ciarĩ ikundi igĩrĩ cia atongoria a ndini ya Ayahudi itaiguanaga. Asadukai matietĩkĩtie ũhoro wa kũriũka kana wa araika.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

kikuyu: Shimei akĩrumana, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Thiĩ na kũu, thiĩ na kũu, wee mũiti wa thakame, wee kĩmaramari gĩkĩ!
english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

kikuyu: Saũlũ akiuga atĩrĩ, “Tũcuukĩrei mĩtĩ niĩ na Jonathani, mũrũ wakwa.” Nake Jonathani akĩgwĩrwo nĩ mũtĩ.
english: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

kikuyu: “Ũcooke ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Ũũ nĩguo Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, Ngai wa Isiraeli, ekuuga: Nyuai, mũrĩĩo na mũtahĩke, mũcooke mũgũe na mũtikanacooke gũũkĩra, nĩ ũndũ wa rũhiũ rwa njora rũrĩa ngaarehithia gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu.’
english: “You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.” ’

kikuyu: Mũndũ agĩkua nĩandaathimaga; nĩndatũmaga ngoro ya mũtumia wa ndigwa ĩine.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

kikuyu: No andũ acio matiigana kũigua. Manase akĩmahĩtithia, nĩũndũwaũguomagĩĩkamaũndũmoorugũkĩrandũrĩrĩiriaJehovaaaniinĩirembereyaandũaIsiraeli.
english: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Na ũndũ wa mũrurumo wa mĩhũmũ ya maniũrũ maku-rĩ, maaĩ nĩmeiganĩrĩire hĩba. Makũmbĩ ma maaĩ makĩrũgama ta rũthingo; maaĩ ma kũrĩa kũriku makĩnyiitana gatagatĩ ka iria.
english: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.

kikuyu: Angĩ maaheetwo wĩra wa kũmenyerera indo cia nyũmba na indo iria ingĩ ciothe ciakoragwo handũ-harĩa-haamũre, o hamwe na mũtu, na ndibei, na maguta, na ũbani, na mahuti marĩa manungi wega.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩwe wombire ciĩga ciakwa cia na thĩinĩ; wanyiitithanirie ndĩ o nda ya maitũ.
english: For you formed my inmost being.  The word elohim, used here, usually means “God” but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”.  Sheol is the place of the dead.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Jehova aathire mũndũ ũcio warĩ na nguo cia gatani, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Oya mwaki kuuma gatagatĩ ka magũrũ macio, kuuma gatagatĩ-inĩ ka akerubi,” mũndũ ũcio agĩtoonya thĩinĩ na akĩrũgama mwena-inĩ wa kũgũrũ kũmwe kwamo.
