english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Nĩagaciara kahĩĩ, nawe nĩũgagatua Jesũ, tondũ nĩwe ũkaahonokia andũ ake kuuma mehia-inĩ mao.”
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus,‡ for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

kikuyu: Ririkanai ũhoro ũrĩa ndamwĩrire atĩrĩ, ‘Gũtirĩ ndungata nene gũkĩra mũmĩathi.’ Angĩkorwo niĩ nĩmanyariirire, o na inyuĩ nĩmakamũnyarira. Angĩkorwo nĩmathĩkĩire ũrutani wakwa o na wanyu nĩmakawathĩkĩra.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’* If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

kikuyu: Wega na thayũ iromũingĩhĩra nĩ ũndũ wa kũmenyana na Ngai, o na Jesũ Mwathani witũ. Kũrũmia Mwĩto na Gũthuurwo kwa Mũndũ
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

kikuyu: Iheo cia o mũndũ iria nyamũre nĩ ciake we mwene, no kĩrĩa angĩhe mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, gĩgaatuĩka kĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũcio.’ ” Ũhoro Ũkoniĩ Mũtumia Ũtarĩ Mwĩhokeku
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’ ”

kikuyu: Andũ a Benjamini maarĩ: Salu mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Hodavia, mũrũ wa Hasenua;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: Ũũgĩ wa arĩa abaarĩrĩri nĩũtũmaga mamenye ũhoro wa njĩra ciao, no ũrimũ wa andũ arĩa akĩĩgu nĩũmahĩtithagia.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

kikuyu: No ndungata yaku, Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni nĩakaũtoonya. Mũmagĩrĩrie, tondũ nĩwe ũgaatongoria Isiraeli mathiĩ makaũgae.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

kikuyu: Arĩngayagĩra, na niĩ ngamwĩtĩka; ndĩrĩkoragwo hamwe nake hĩndĩ ya thĩĩna, ndĩrĩmũteithũraga na ngamũtĩĩithia.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

kikuyu: na ũgerere Berotha na Sibiraimu (kũu mũhaka-inĩ ũrĩa ũrĩ gatagatĩ ka Dameski na Hamathu), ũthiĩ nginya Hazeri-Hatikoni, kũu mũhaka-inĩ wa Haurani.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Loti aahindahindire-rĩ, andũ acio makĩmũnyiita guoko, na moko ma mũtumia wake na ma airĩtu ake eerĩ, na makĩmoimagaria o wega nginya nja ya itũũra rĩu inene, nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩamaiguĩrĩire tha.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

kikuyu: Nĩngerĩhĩria harĩo na rĩĩrĩhĩria inene na ndĩmaherithie ndĩ na mangʼũrĩ. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ngeerĩhĩria harĩo.’ ”
english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Ũtukũ ũcio kiugo kĩa Ngai gĩgĩkinyĩra Nathani, akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

kikuyu: “Mawatho ma kũrũmĩrĩrwo mangĩkeherio maitho-inĩ makwa-rĩ, norĩo njiaro cia Isiraeli ingĩtiga gũtuĩka rũrĩrĩ maitho-inĩ makwa,”
english: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says Yahweh, “then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before me forever.”

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ngaatua Samaria hĩba ya mahiga, gũtuĩke kũndũ gwa kũhaandagwo mĩthabibũ. Nĩngaita mahiga marĩo mũkuru-inĩ na thikũrie mĩthingi yarĩo.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

kikuyu: “Inyuĩ mũhaicaga ndigiri njerũ, mũikarĩire matandĩko manyu, na inyuĩ mũthiiaga na njĩra, cũraniai,
english: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.

kikuyu: Na gũgĩkinya atĩrĩ, mwaka-inĩ wa mĩrongo ĩtatũ na mũgwanja kuuma rĩrĩa Jekonia, mũthamaki waJuda, aatwarirwobũrũriũngĩ, mwaka-inĩũrĩaEvili-MerodakiaatuĩkiremũthamakiwaBabuloni-rĩ, nĩohorithirie Jekonia mũthamaki wa Juda, akĩmũrekereria oime njeera mũthenya wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtano wa mweri wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

kikuyu: Wĩrire waganu ũyũ na ũhooe Mwathani. Hihi nĩegũkũrekera nĩ ũndũ wa gũkorwo na rĩciiria ta rĩu ngoro-inĩ yaku.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

kikuyu: Nĩakĩire mĩhianano yothe ya mbũtũ cia njata cia igũrũ igongona kũu nja cierĩ cia hekarũ ya Jehova.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Narĩo igũrũ rĩanagĩrĩra ũthingu wake, nĩgũkorwo Ngai we mwene nĩwe mũtuanĩri ciira.
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

kikuyu: oyai mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio wĩkĩte ũndũ ũcio mũũru mũmũtware kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa itũũra rĩanyu inene na inyuĩ mũmũhũre na mahiga nyuguto nginya akue.
english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

kikuyu: Nake Saũlũ agĩũkĩra, akĩrũgama, no rĩrĩa aahingũririe maitho ndoonaga o na hanini. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩmũnyiita guoko makĩmũtwara Dameski.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

kikuyu: inyuĩ mũtungataga thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Jehova, o inyuĩ mũrũgamaga nja-inĩ cia nyũmba ya Ngai witũ.
english: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wake mwako wothe nĩũnyiitanĩte, na ũgakĩneneha o nginya ũgatuĩka hekarũ theru thĩinĩ wa Mwathani.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

kikuyu: Nake Jehoashu mũthamaki wa Isiraeli akĩnyiita Amazia mũthamaki wa Juda, mũrũ wa Joashu, mũrũ wa Ahazia, o kũu Bethi-Shemeshu. Ningĩ Jehoashu akĩmũrehe Jerusalemu, na akĩmomora rũthingo rwa Jerusalemu kuuma Kĩhingo kĩa Efiraimu nginya Kĩhingo gĩa Koine, handũ ha buti ta 600† kũraiha.
english: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.§

kikuyu: kũrĩ na mĩgambo ya aini itahĩro-inĩ rĩa maaĩ. Mainaga ciĩko cia ũthingu cia Jehova, ciĩko cia ũthingu cia njamba ciake kũu Isiraeli. “Ningĩ andũ a Jehova magĩikũrũka nginya ihingo-inĩ cia itũũra inene.
english: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then Yahweh’s people went down to the gates.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũrĩa njũũĩ tu nĩ atĩ, Roho Mũtheru nĩandaaraga atĩ matũũra-inĩ mothe, njeera na mathĩĩna nĩcio injetereire.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

kikuyu: Nake Jothamu akĩhurũka hamwe na maithe make, agĩthikwo hamwe nao itũũra inene rĩa Daudi, na norĩo itũũra rĩa ithe. Nake mũriũ Ahazu agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Zera ũrĩa Mũkushi agĩũka kũmũũkĩrĩra arĩ na mbũtũ nene ya thigari na ngaari cia ita 300, nake agĩũka agĩkinya Maresha.
english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

kikuyu: Ndarongoririe Jehova, nake akĩnjĩtĩka, akĩndeithũra kuuma kũrĩ maũndũ marĩa mothe maanjĩkagĩra guoya.
english: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

kikuyu: Nao magĩikara na arutwo kũu ihinda iraaya.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

kikuyu: Firaũni akiuga atĩrĩ, “Hĩ! Kaĩ Jehova arogĩikara na inyuĩ ingĩmũrekereria mũthiĩ na atumia anyu na ciana cianyu-ĩ! Hatirĩ nganja mũrĩ na muoroto mũũru.
english: He said to them, “Yahweh be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

kikuyu: nake Jesii aarĩ ithe wa Mũthamaki Daudi. Daudi aarĩ ithe wa Solomoni, ũrĩa nyina aarĩ mũtumia wa Uria,
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king‡ became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

kikuyu: Arauna akĩĩra Daudi atĩrĩ, “Reke mũthamaki mwathi wakwa oe kĩrĩa gĩothe angĩenda akĩrute igongona. Ici nĩ ndegwa cia igongona rĩa njino, na ici nĩcio indo cia kũhuhĩra ngano namo macooki ma ndegwa matuĩke ngũ.
english: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

kikuyu: Geithiai ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ othe na ngeithi theru cia kĩmumunyano.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: 807 Rwĩmbo 8:11 8 1 Naarĩ korwo no ũtuĩke ta mũrũ wa maitũ, ũrĩa wongire nyondo cia maitũ! Hĩndĩ ĩyo, ingĩgũtũnga nja, ndaakũmumunya, na gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũngĩĩmena.
english: h that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

kikuyu: mũndũ ũcio nĩathũire mũndũ ũrĩa wĩkaga maũndũ mooru, no nĩatĩĩte arĩa etigĩri Jehova, na ndagaga kũhingia mwĩhĩtwa wake, o na ũngĩkorwo ũrĩ wa kũmũtuuria,
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩrutũrũra ndũrĩrĩ ciehere mbere yao, na akĩmagaĩra bũrũri ũcio wa ndũrĩrĩ ũtuĩke igai rĩao; akĩhe mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli mĩciĩ yao.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũthamaki wa Ashuri agĩathana atĩrĩ: “Reke mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũmwe wa arĩa maatahirwo kuuma Samaria acooke agatũũre kuo, nĩgeetha arute andũ ũrĩa ngai ya bũrũri ũcio yendaga.”
english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him† go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”

kikuyu: Maitĩrĩrie maguta o ta ũrĩa ũitĩrĩirie ithe wao, nĩguo mandungatĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai. Gũitĩrĩrio maguta kwao nĩkũmatoonyia ũtungata-inĩ wa ũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa ũgũtũũra njiarwa-inĩ ciothe iria igooka.”
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo kĩrĩa haandĩte kĩrorĩĩo nĩ andũ angĩ, nacio irio cia mĩgũnda yakwa iromunywo.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

kikuyu: Tondũ nĩnjĩĩrĩtwo nĩ kiugo kĩa Jehova atĩrĩ, ‘Ndũkanarĩe irio kana ũnyue maaĩ kũu o na kana ũcookere njĩra ĩrĩa wagereire ũgĩthiĩ.’ ”
english: For it was said to me by Yahweh’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’ ”

kikuyu: na ũtuoherere ndaamĩ-inĩ cia kĩande cia ebodi, tũrĩ tũhiga twa kĩririkania kĩa ariũ a Isiraeli. Harũni nĩarĩkuuaga marĩĩtwa macio ciande-inĩ ciake matuĩke kĩririkania mbere ya Jehova.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

kikuyu: na inyuothe mũngĩthiĩ mwĩohete indo cia mbaara, mũringe Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũrĩ mbere ya Jehova o nginya rĩrĩa akaingata thũ ciake ciume mbere yake,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

kikuyu: Hwaĩ-inĩ arutwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ magĩũka kũrĩ we makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ingata andũ aya nĩguo mathiĩ mĩciĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hakuhĩ o na mĩgũnda-inĩ mageethe irio na gwa gũkoma, tondũ haha tũrĩ nĩ werũ ũtarĩ andũ.”
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

kikuyu: Akorwo ti ũguo, nĩirekwo ciũke ciĩhithe kũrĩ niĩ; nĩirekwo icarie thayũ na niĩ, ĩĩ ti-itherũ nĩicarie thayũ na niĩ.”
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

kikuyu: Na inyuĩ athuuri-rĩ, endagai atumia anyu na mũtikamakũũmage.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩwe ũgaatuĩka mũthamaki wa thĩ yothe. Mũthenya ũcio gũgaakorwo Jehova arĩ o we wiki, narĩo rĩĩtwa rĩake rĩkorwo no rĩo riiki.
english: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

kikuyu: “Nake Zebuluni aheo gĩcigo kĩmwe; nakĩo gĩkaahakana na rũgongo rwa Isakaru kuuma mwena wa irathĩro nginya mwena wa ithũĩro.
english: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.

kikuyu: Esaũ akiuga atĩrĩ, “Githĩ nĩ ma nĩkĩo etagwo Jakubu? Arĩ kũũheenia maita maya meerĩ;* nĩoire ũrigithathi wakwa, na rĩu nĩoya kĩrathimo gĩakwa!” Agĩcooka akĩũria ithe atĩrĩ, “Ndũnandigĩria kĩrathimo o na kĩmwe?”
english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

kikuyu: Jesũ ndetĩkĩririe mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ amũrũmĩrĩre, o tiga Petero na Jakubu na Johana mũrũ wa nyina na Jakubu.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

kikuyu: Mũnene ũcio wa thigari agĩũka akĩmũnyiita na agĩathana ohwo na mĩnyororo ĩĩrĩ. Agĩcooka akĩũria aarĩ ũ na nĩ atĩa ekĩte.
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

kikuyu: Rũmbũyagia atumia arĩa a ndigwa kũna, na ũmatĩĩage.
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa wega ũrĩa Ngai aaheete, niĩ nĩ gwaka ndaakire mũthingi haana ta mwakithia ũrĩa mũũgĩ nake mũndũ ũngĩ nĩ gwaka araaka igũrũ rĩa mũthingi ũcio. No o mũndũ nĩamenyagĩrĩre ũrĩa egwaka igũrũ rĩaguo.
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on  Jeremiah 9:24  Isaiah 64:4  Isaiah 40:13

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio Jesũ, o akĩrutanaga kũu hekarũ-inĩ, akĩanĩrĩra, akiuga atĩrĩ; “Ĩĩ nĩguo, nĩmũnjũũĩ, na mũkamenya kũrĩa nyumĩte. Ndiũkĩte gũkũ nĩ ũndũ wakwa niĩ mwene, no ũrĩa wandũmire nĩ wa ma. Inyuĩ mũtimũũĩ,
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I

kikuyu: Ikaragai mũkenete nĩ ũndũ mũrĩ na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro, na mũkiragĩrĩrie hĩndĩ ya mathĩĩna, na mũikarage mũkĩhooyaga hĩndĩ ciothe.
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩmambatĩte, magathiĩ Ashuri, ta ndigiri ya gĩthaka ĩkĩũrũra ĩrĩ iiki. Efiraimu nĩeyendetie kũrĩ endwa ake.
english: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.

kikuyu: Nake Esiteri akĩmũ- taarĩria ũrĩa ekwĩra Moridekai, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ,
english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, ũyũ nĩguo ũhoro wa Esaũ (na nowe Edomu).
english: ow this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

kikuyu: na Zadoku, mwanake mũnini warĩ njamba ya ita ĩrĩ ũrũme, ũrĩa warĩ na anene a thigari mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na eerĩ kuuma nyũmba yake;
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

kikuyu: Mahaloni na Kilioni o nao magĩkua, nake Naomi agĩtigwo atarĩ na ariũ ake eerĩ, o na kana mũthuuri.
english: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngamũkuhĩrĩria ndĩmũciirithie na ndĩmũtuĩre. Nĩngahiũha gũtuĩka mũira wa gũtuĩra ciira arogi, na itharia, na arĩa mehĩtaga na maheeni, na njũkĩrĩre arĩa matunyaga aruti wĩra mĩcaara yao, na arĩa mahinyagĩrĩria atumia a ndigwa na ciana iria itarĩ maithe, na arĩa maagithagia ageni kĩhooto na makaaga kwĩĩndigĩra,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ekuuga. Kũiya Indo cia Ngai
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

kikuyu: ehova nĩerire Mwathani wakwa atĩrĩ: “Ikara guoko-inĩ gwakwa kwa ũrĩo, nginya rĩrĩa ngaatũma thũ ciaku ituĩke gaturwa ka makinya maku.”*
english: ahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ruithiai ngoro cianyu na mũtigacooke kũũmia ngingo cianyu rĩngĩ.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma mathũũrwo mũno, matuĩke kĩndũ gĩa gũthirĩkia mothamaki mothe ma gũkũ thĩ, na mameneke na matuĩke a kuunagwo thimo, na matũũre mathekagĩrĩrwo na manyiitagwo nĩ kĩrumi kũrĩa guothe ngaamathaamĩria.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

kikuyu: Nĩwarekeire andũ aku waganu wao, na ũkĩhumbĩra mehia mao mothe.
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Obadia aathiiaga-rĩ, agĩtũngana na Elija. Obadia akĩmũmenya, akĩinamĩrĩra, agĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ, akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ti-itherũ nĩwe, mwathi wakwa Elija?”
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

kikuyu: No niĩ-rĩ, ndĩrĩkũrutagĩra igongona ngĩinaga rwĩmbo rwa gũcookia ngaatho. Nĩngahingia mĩĩhĩtwa yakwa ĩrĩa niĩ ndanehĩta. Ũhonokio uumaga kũrĩ Jehova.”
english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Nĩndigagĩrĩria magũrũ makwa matikagerere njĩra o yothe njũru, nĩgeetha njathĩkagĩre kiugo gĩaku.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

kikuyu: Tondũ rũrĩrĩ ruumĩte mwena wa gathigathini nĩrũkamũtharĩkĩra, na rwanange bũrũri wake. Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũgaatũũra kuo; andũ nĩmakoora o hamwe na nyamũ.
english: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.

kikuyu: Wendani ndũthiraga. No akorwo nĩ morathi, nĩmagathira; o na thiomi nĩigathira; na kũmenya maũndũ o nakuo nĩgũgathira.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

kikuyu: No ha ũhoro wanyu-rĩ, gĩai na hinya na mũtigatiganĩrie ũhoro ũcio, nĩgũkorwo nĩ mũkaarĩhwo wĩra ũrĩa mũrutaga.”
english: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”

kikuyu: Nowe agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, nĩndĩhaarĩirie gũikio njeera o na gũkuanĩra hamwe nawe.”
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

kikuyu: We Kiugo agĩtuĩka mũndũ na agĩtũũrania na ithuĩ. Nĩtuonete riiri wake, riiri wa Mũrũ wake wa Mũmwe, ũrĩa woimire kũrĩ Ithe aiyũrĩtwo nĩ ũtugi na ũhoro wa ma.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born‡ Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na ĩtano kũrĩ Biliga, na wa ikũmi na ĩtandatũ kũrĩ Imeri,
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

kikuyu: Itugĩ iria itiirĩrĩire igũrũ nĩ ithingithaga,
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

kikuyu: nginya rĩrĩa Jehova agaacũthĩrĩria arĩ igũrũ oone.
english: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.

kikuyu: Thũ ciakwa ciothe iheehanagĩra nĩguo iinjũkĩrĩre; injiiragĩrĩra maũndũ mooru mũno, ikoiga atĩrĩ,
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

kikuyu: “Geragiainahinyagũtoonyeramũrangoũrĩamũceke; tondũngũmwĩraatĩrĩ, andũ aingĩ nĩ makaageria gũtoonya, no matikahota.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ we mwĩrĩ wothe ũnyiitithanagio na ũkohanio hamwe nĩ nga iria iũnyiitithanagia, naguo ũgakũraga na ũkeyakaga guo mwene thĩinĩ wa wendani, o kĩĩga gĩkĩrutaga wĩra wakĩo. Gũtũũra ta Ciana cia Ũtheri
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Joshua aarĩkia gwĩka ũguo, arũme arĩa moohetie andũ magĩũkĩra narua, magĩtengʼera na ihenya, magĩtoonya itũũra rĩu na makĩrĩtunyana, ningĩ makĩrĩgwatia mwaki o narua.
english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.

kikuyu: Ningĩ acooke arute nguo icio, ehumbe ingĩ, eherie mũhu ũcio aũtware nja ya kambĩ handũ hatarĩ thaahu.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

kikuyu: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga-inĩ wa Manase maarĩ andũ 32,200.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Watũmire atigie o hanini aiganane na araika, na ũkĩmũhumba thũmbĩ ya riiri o na gĩtĩĩo,
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.†

kikuyu: Mũigana wao ũgĩcooka ũkĩnyiiha, na makĩagithio hinya, nĩ kũhinyĩrĩrio, na kũnyariirĩka, o na kĩeha;
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

kikuyu: Nĩaarutire andũ ake makiuma kũu makenete, akĩruta acio ake athuure makĩanagĩrĩra nĩ gũkena;
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

kikuyu: Amazia agĩcooka akĩbanga thigari ciake, agĩcitongoria na mwena wa Gĩtuamba gĩa Cumbĩ, kũrĩa ooragire andũ 10,000 a Seiru.
english: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

kikuyu: Andũ othe arĩa maatũũraga Lida na Sharoni makĩmuona na makĩgarũrũkĩra Mwathani.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: Nyamũ ĩrĩa yarĩ kuo, na rĩu ndĩrĩ ho, nĩyo mũthamaki wa kanana. We nĩ ũmwe wa acio mũgwanja, na rĩu erekeire kwanangwo.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

kikuyu: ũngĩkorwo ũrĩ mũtheru na mũrũngĩrĩru-rĩ, o na rĩu no arahũke nĩ ũndũ waku nĩguo agũcookie handũ harĩa hakwagĩrĩire.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩũkahaanda mĩgũnda ya mĩthabibũ kũu irĩma-inĩ cia Samaria; arĩmi nĩmakamĩhaanda, na makenere maciaro mayo.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa watho-rĩ, Musa aatwathire tũhũũrage atumia ta aya na mahiga nyuguto. Rĩu we ũkuuga atĩa?”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, wee ũroiga atĩrĩ, ‘Mũrungu nĩ atĩa angĩmenya? No atuanĩre ciira nduma-inĩ ta ĩno?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

kikuyu: atĩ andũ aaganu nĩmeyumĩrĩtie thĩinĩ wanyu na makahĩtithia andũ a itũũra rĩao njĩra, makameera atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũthiĩi tũkahooe ngai ingĩ” (ngai iria inyuĩ mũtooĩ),
english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

kikuyu: na Hadidi, na Zeboimu na Nebalati,
english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

kikuyu: No angĩ makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ĩno ti mĩario ya mũndũ ũrĩ na ndaimono. Ndaimono no ĩhingũre maitho ma mũtumumu?” Kwaga gwĩtĩkia kwa Ayahudi
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”*

kikuyu: Tondũ andũ a Isiraeli nĩ ndungata ciakwa, iria ndaarutire bũrũri wa Misiri, matikanendio matuĩke ngombo.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmũkamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, rĩrĩa ngaahingũra mbĩrĩra cianyu ndĩmwambatie muume kuo, inyuĩ andũ aya akwa.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

kikuyu: Rũgongo rũrĩa maatũũraga ruoimĩte Mesha rũgathiĩ rũrorete Sefari, kũu mwena wa irathĩro wa bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kikuyu: na a mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri maarĩ 12,000, na a mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali maarĩ 12,000, na a mũhĩrĩga wa Manase† maarĩ 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Jehova akĩũmia ngoro ya Firaũni mũthamaki wa bũrũri wa Misiri, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩrũmĩrĩra andũ a Isiraeli na ihenya arĩa moimagarĩte makinyũkĩtie na ũcamba.
english: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.†

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, hĩndĩ ĩmwe Afarisai nĩmoririe Jesũ rĩrĩa ũthamaki wa Ngai ũgooka. Nake akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Ũthamaki wa Ngai ndũũkaga na imenyithia iria mũngĩĩrorera,
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

kikuyu: nĩngwĩka o ũguo wahooya. Nĩngũkũhe ngoro ĩ na ũũgĩ na gũkũũrana, nĩguo gũtuĩke atĩ gũtirĩ kwagĩa mũndũ ũngĩ tawe, na gũtirĩ hĩndĩ gũkaagĩa ũngĩ tawe.
english: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

kikuyu: Nacio itikahaane ta maithe macio ma tene, arĩa maarĩ a rũciaro rũremi na rũngʼathia, rũrĩa ngoro ciaruo itaathĩkagĩra Mũrungu, o rũu maroho maaruo mataamwĩhokire.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũthingataga ũthingu na wendani nĩagĩĩaga na muoyo, na ũgaacĩru, na gĩtĩĩo.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩarĩria Ayubu arĩ kĩhuhũkanio-inĩ, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ:
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind:

kikuyu: Kuuma iruta-inĩ rĩu rĩa ũiguano, nĩakarutĩra Jehova nyama imwe cia gũcinwo na mwaki: nacio nĩ rũambũ rũrĩa ruothe rũhumbĩire nyama cia nda na rũrĩa rũnyiitaine nacio,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: na Seraia, na Azaria, na Jeremia,
english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

kikuyu: na Hukoku, na Rehobu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: ũndũ ũrĩa ũikaraga omĩtie ngingo thuutha wa kũrũithio maita maingĩ, akaanangwo o rĩmwe, na aage kĩhonia.
english: e who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

kikuyu: ngiumagara ũtukũ ndĩ na andũ matarĩ aingĩ. Ndierĩte mũndũ o na ũmwe ũndũ ũrĩa Ngai wakwa eekĩrĩte ngoro-inĩ yakwa njĩke nĩ ũndũ wa Jerusalemu. Gũtiarĩ na mbarathi ingĩ tiga ĩrĩa yanguuĩte.
english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

kikuyu: Nĩũtũmĩte andũ aku makorwo na mahinda maritũ; ũmanyuithĩtie ndibei magathiĩ magĩtũgũũgaga.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Andũ makayaga nĩ icooki rĩa kũhinyĩrĩrio; mathaithanaga mateithũrwo guoko-inĩ kwa ũcio ũrĩ hinya mũingĩ.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, Mũriũ ndarĩ ũndũ angĩĩka we mwene, tiga o ũrĩa onaga Ithe agĩĩka, nĩgũkorwo maũndũ marĩa Ithe ekaga no mo Mũriũ o nake ekaga.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do  1:00 p.m.  NU omits from “waiting” in verse 3 to the end of verse 4.

kikuyu: Nake akĩĩra ithe atĩrĩ, “Wũi mũtwe-ĩ! Wũi mũtwe-ĩ!” Nake ithe akĩĩra ndungata atĩrĩ, “Mũkuue ũmũtwarĩre nyina.”
english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

kikuyu: na kuuma njiaro cia Shefatia, aarĩ Zebadia mũrũ wa Mikaeli, hamwe na andũ angĩ 80;
english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

kikuyu: akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ aambaga kũruta ndibei ĩrĩa njega, na ageni maarĩkia kũnyua mũno, agacooka akaruta ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ njega; no wee ũkũigĩte ĩrĩa njega nginya rĩu.”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, nĩngagũtua kĩhũũri kĩa ngano, kĩhũũri kĩerũ na kĩũgĩ, kĩna magego maingĩ. Nĩũkahũũra irĩma na ũcihehenje, natuo tũrĩma ũtũtue mũũngũ.
english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

kikuyu: Mũtikambate tondũ Jehova ndarĩ hamwe na inyuĩ. Nĩmũkũhootwo nĩ thũ cianyu,
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

kikuyu: Mũraika wa Mwathani akĩmoimĩrĩra, naguo riiri wa Mwathani ũkĩmatherera hau maarĩ, nao makĩnyiitwo nĩ guoya.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

kikuyu: Makĩria ma ũguo, nĩwe wathuurirwo nĩ makanitha nĩguo atwarane na ithuĩ ũhoro-inĩ wa mũhothi ũcio wa ũtaana, o ũcio tũrutagĩra wĩra nĩguo tũgoocithie Mwathani we mwene, na tuonanie kĩyo kĩrĩa tũrĩ nakĩo gĩa kwenda gũteithia.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mbaara-inĩ ĩngĩ ĩrĩa yarĩ kũu Gathu, nakuo kwarĩ na mũndũ mũnene mũno, warĩ na ciara ithathatũ o guoko, na ciara ithathatũ o kũgũrũ, ciothe ciarĩ ciara mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na inya. O na ningĩ aarĩ wa rũciaro rwa Rafa.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

kikuyu: Maũndũ-inĩmothe, tuĩkakĩonereriagĩagwĩkagawegamaũndũ-inĩmothe. Rĩrĩaũkũrutanaonanagia
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

kikuyu: Ũrĩa warũmĩrĩire aarĩ Shama mũrũ wa Agee ũrĩa Mũharari. Rĩrĩa Afilisti monganire hamwe handũ haarĩ mũgũnda waiyũrĩte ndengũ, ita rĩa Isiraeli rĩkĩmoorĩra.
english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

kikuyu: ehova nĩarathamaka, thĩ nĩĩgĩkene; mabũrũri marĩa marĩ ndwere-inĩ cia iria nĩmacanjamũke.
english: ahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

kikuyu: Wee Mwathani, ingĩkiuga atĩa, kuona atĩ Isiraeli nĩmatooretio nĩ thũ ciao?
english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?

kikuyu: Harũni na ariũ ake marĩrĩagĩra nyama cia ndũrũme ĩyo na mĩgate kuuma gĩkabũ-inĩ o hau itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: icio magĩciigĩrĩra ithũri-inĩ, nake Harũni agĩcinĩra maguta macio kĩgongona-inĩ.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

kikuyu: Kore mũrũ wa Imuna ũrĩa Mũlawii, mũikaria wa Kĩhingo kĩa Mwena wa Irathĩro, nĩwe warĩ mũroriwaindoiriaciarutagĩrwoNgainakwĩyendera, akagayagamĩhothiĩrĩaĩrutĩirwoJehovahamwe na iheo iria nyamũre.
english: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute Yahweh’s offerings and the most holy things.

kikuyu: mũthenya ũcio mũndũ ũũrĩte kwao nĩagakũrehera ũhoro.
english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

kikuyu: Nake Elisha agĩtiganĩria ndegwa ciake akĩrũmĩrĩra Elija. Akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Njĩtĩkĩria ngoigĩre baba na maitũ ũhoro, njooke njũke tũthiĩ nawe.” Nake Elija akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Cooka, kaĩ arĩ atĩa ndagwĩka?”
english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

kikuyu: Cuuria gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio na ngathĩka, na ũcooke ũige ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira thuutha wa gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio. Gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio kĩhakanie Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru na Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno.§
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

kikuyu: kana mũrogani wa ithitũ, kana mũndũ ũrĩ na maroho ma kũragũra, kana mũrogi, o na kana mũndũ ũkaragũra na maroho ma andũ akuũ.
english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Kũrathimwo nĩ arĩa maiguaga kiugo kĩa Ngai na magagĩathĩkĩra.” Kĩmenyithia kĩa Jona
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

kikuyu: Ũngĩaga kũrũmĩrĩra wega ciugo ciothe cia watho ũyũ, iria ciandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩĩrĩ, na wage gũtĩĩa rĩĩtwa rĩĩrĩ rĩrĩ riiri na rĩa gwĩtigĩrwo, rĩa Jehova Ngai waku,
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

kikuyu: Mũthamaki wa Babuloni arĩ kũu Ribila nĩoragithirie ariũ a Zedekia o hau maitho-inĩ ma ithe wao; agĩcooka akĩũragithia anene othe a Juda.
english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũhoro wa hitho wa kũregana na watho nĩũraruta wĩra; no nĩ kũrĩ ũrĩa ũgirĩrĩirie ũhoro ũcio woneke rĩu, na egũthiĩ na mbere gwĩka ũguo nginya rĩrĩa akeeherio.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

kikuyu: Nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakoya gatũrũme kau ka iruta rĩa mahĩtia, hamwe na kabakũri ka maguta, acithũngũthĩrie mbere ya Jehova ituĩke iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Gũtaũkĩrwo wega nĩ maũndũ gũtũmaga mũndũ endeke, no njĩra ya arĩa matarĩ ehokeku ti hũthũ.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe angĩrĩa maguta ma nyamũ ĩrutĩirwo Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki, no nginya aingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Ashuri ithe wa Tekoa aarĩ na atumia eerĩ, nĩo Hela na Naara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

kikuyu: Wee ũkoretwo ũrĩ rĩũrĩro rĩa athĩĩni, na rĩũrĩro rĩa abatari hĩndĩ ya mĩnyamaro yao, handũ ha kũũrĩra hĩndĩ ya kĩhuhũkanio, o na ta kĩĩruru gĩa kwĩyũa riũa. Nĩgũkorwo mĩhũmũ ya arĩa matarĩ tha ĩhaana kĩhuhũkanio kĩrĩa kĩgũthaga rũthingo na nditi,
english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Ngai akiumĩrĩra Abimeleku ũtukũ na kĩroto, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee-rĩ, no ta ũkuĩte tondũ mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio woete nĩ mũtumia wene.”
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngwĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe thĩinĩ wanyu wagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũrĩa thakame, o na mũgeni ũrĩa ũtũũranagia na inyuĩ ndakanarĩe thakame.”
english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

kikuyu: ĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, kuona atĩ kĩĩranĩro gĩa gũtoonya ũhurũko-inĩ wake kĩrĩ o ho-rĩ, nĩtwĩmenyererei gũtikagĩe o na ũmwe wanyu ũtagagĩkinyĩra.
english: et’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

kikuyu: Nao magĩkira na ũhoro ũcio, no makooranagia o ene atĩrĩ, “kũriũka kuuma kũrĩ akuũ nĩ kuuga atĩa.”
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

kikuyu: Nacio ciama ici nĩ igatwaranaga na arĩa metĩkĩtie: Nĩmakaingata ndaimono thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa; na nĩmakaaria na thiomi njerũ;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

kikuyu: Samusoni akĩhooya Jehova, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Wee Mwathani Jehova, ndirikana. Wee Ngai, ndagũthaitha ũnjĩkĩre hinya o ihinda rĩngĩ rĩmwe, na ũreke ndĩĩrĩhĩrie kũrĩ Afilisti na igũtha rĩmwe nĩ ũndũ wa maitho makwa meerĩ.”
english: Samson called to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli arĩa maarĩ mwena ũcio ũngĩ wa kĩanda na arĩa maarĩ mũrĩmo wa Jorodani moonire atĩ mbũtũ ya ita ya Isiraeli nĩyoora, na atĩ Saũlũ na ariũ ake nĩmakuĩte-rĩ, magĩtiganĩria matũũra mao makĩũra. Nao Afilisti magĩthiĩ magĩtũũra kuo.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai-rĩ, ririkana atĩ muoyo wakwa no ta mĩhũmũ; namo maitho makwa matigacooka kuona ũndũ mwega rĩngĩ.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

kikuyu: Githĩ gĩkombe gĩkĩ tikĩo mwathi wakwa anyuuaga nakĩo na akaragũra nakĩo? Ũndũ ũyũ mwĩkĩte nĩ ũndũ mũũru mũno.’ ”
english: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’ ”

kikuyu: No Ngai akĩmũriũkia kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ, akĩmuohora ruo-inĩ rwa gĩkuũ, tondũ gũtingĩahotekire atũũre anyiitĩtwo nĩkĩo.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

kikuyu: Andũ acio makĩhũndũka, magĩthiĩ makĩĩra arutwo arĩa angĩ; no-o nao makĩrega kũmetĩkia.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

kikuyu: Jehu agĩũkĩra, akĩingĩra nyũmba. Nake mũnabii agĩitĩrĩria Jehu maguta mũtwe, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli ekuuga ũũ: ‘Ndagũitĩrĩria maguta ũtuĩke mũthamaki wa andũ a Jehova a Isiraeli.
english: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of Yahweh, even over Israel.

kikuyu: nĩguo wĩtĩkio wanyu ndũgakorwo ũtiirĩrĩirwo nĩ ũũgĩ wa andũ, o tiga hinya wa Ngai. Ũũgĩ Uumanĩte na Roho
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jesũ nĩathĩte ngoma ĩyo thũku yume thĩinĩ wa mũndũ ũcio. Nĩyamũnyiitaga kaingĩ, na o na gũtuĩka nĩoohagwo moko na magũrũ na mĩnyororo, na akarangĩrwo-rĩ, nĩatuangaga mĩnyororo ĩyo yamuohaga, na ndaimono ĩyo ĩgatũma athiĩ kũndũ gũtarĩ andũ.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa kũguoyohia mũno mũndũ gũkumbatwo nĩ Ngai ũrĩa ũrĩ muoyo.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

kikuyu: “No ithuĩ-rĩ, Jehova nĩwe Ngai witũ, na tũtimũtiganĩirie. Athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa matungataga Jehova nĩ ariũ a Harũni, na mateithagĩrĩrio nĩ Alawii.
english: “But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

kikuyu: Nĩũtahĩte ngoro yakwa, wee mwarĩ wa maitũ, o wee mũhiki wakwa; nĩũtahĩte ngoro yakwa na irora o rĩmwe rĩa maitho maku, na ithaga rĩmwe rĩa mũgathĩ waku wa ngingo.
english: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo matukũ make mothe, wĩra wake nĩ wa ruo na kĩeha; o na ũtukũ, meciiria make matihurũkaga. Ũndũ ũcio o naguo no wa tũhũ.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Njĩra njariĩ ya arĩa arũngĩrĩru yeheragĩra ũũru; mũndũ ũrĩa ũmenyagĩrĩra mĩthiĩre yake nĩ muoyo wake mwene agitagĩra.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

kikuyu: Nake ndakanahikie atumia aingĩ, nĩguo ngoro yake ndĩkanagarũrũke. Ningĩ ndakaneingĩhĩrie betha na thahabu.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

kikuyu: nao andũ maarĩ 16,000.
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

kikuyu: No ti andũ othe mooĩ ũguo. Andũ amwe nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa matũũrĩte mamenyerete mĩhianano, o na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mekũrĩa irio ta icio meciiragia atĩ nĩirutĩirwo mũhianano, na tondũ thamiri ciao itirĩ hinya-rĩ, makanyiitwo nĩ thaahu.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

kikuyu: akĩĩra kahĩĩ kau atĩrĩ, “Tengʼera ũgacarie mĩguĩ ĩrĩa ngũikia.” Na rĩrĩa kahĩĩ kau gaatengʼeraga-rĩ, agĩikia mũguĩ mbere yako.
english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ ciĩko ciaku, o na wĩra waku mũritũ, o na ũkirĩrĩria waku. Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ ndũngĩkirĩrĩria andũ arĩa aaganu, na atĩ andũ arĩa moigaga nĩ atũmwo no ti atũmwo nĩwamageririe, na ũkĩmenya atĩ nĩ a maheeni.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

kikuyu: Ciarĩ na mĩtingʼoe, o na mboora ta cia tũngʼaurũ, na mĩtingʼoe-inĩ yacio ciarĩ na ũhoti wa kũnyariira andũ ihinda rĩa mĩeri ĩtano.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

kikuyu: Ndatũherithagia ta ũrĩa mehia maitũ magĩrĩirwo, o na kana agatũrĩhia kũringana na waganu witũ ũrĩa ũigana.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

kikuyu: “Ndũkanagwete rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova Ngai waku na itherũ, nĩgũkorwo Jehova ndagatua atĩ mũndũ ndehĩtie ũrĩa ũgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩake na itherũ.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God;† for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo niĩ ndĩ mũira atĩ maaheanire indo o ta ũrĩa maahotire, o na makĩruta makĩria ma ũrĩa mangĩahotire, nĩ ũndũ wa kwĩyendera kwao.
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

kikuyu: Elisha akĩmũkũũrĩra maitho amũrorete nginya Hazaeli agĩconoka. Nake mũndũ wa Ngai akĩambĩrĩria kũrĩra.
english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩigua mũgambo uumĩte igũrũ ũtariĩ ta mũhũyũko wa maaĩ maratherera na ningĩ ta mũrurumo wa ngwa. Mũgambo ũcio ndaiguire watariĩ ta wa aini a inanda cia mũgeeto makĩina na inanda ciao.
english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

kikuyu: Niĩ ndĩ ndungata yaku; he gũkũũrana maũndũ, nĩguo hote gũtaũkĩrwo nĩ kĩrĩra gĩaku.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

kikuyu: Kũrĩ Ayahudi rĩu rĩarĩ ihinda rĩa gũkena, na kũigua wega na gũcanjamũka o na gũtĩĩka.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

kikuyu: Gũtigacooka kũgĩa ũtukũ. Nao matikabatario nĩ ũtheri wa tawa o na kana ũtheri wa riũa, nĩgũkorwo Mwathani Ngai nĩwe ũgaatuĩka ũtheri wao. Nao magaathamaka tene na tene.
english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.  TR and NU omit “sinners”  The word for “sorcerers” here also includes users of potions and drugs.  12,012 stadia = 2,221 kilometers or 1,380 miles. TR reads 12,000 stadia instead of 12,012 stadia.  144 cubits is about 65.8 meters or 216 feet  or, lapis lazuli  TR adds “pure”

kikuyu: nĩgeetha mũtikanethũkie na gwĩthondekera mũhianano mũicũhie, mũhiano wa kĩndũ o gĩothe, ũthondeketwo ũrĩ mũhianĩre wa mũndũ mũrũme kana wa mũndũ-wa-nja,
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩ nja ya mũndũ kĩngĩmũgwatia ‘thaahu’ nĩ ũndũ wa gũtoonya thĩinĩ wake. No rĩrĩ, kĩrĩa kiumaga thĩinĩ wa mũndũ nĩkĩo kĩmũgwatagia ‘thaahu’.”
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.  See Job 9:8  or, “I AM!”  or, tassel  Isaiah 29:13  Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũngĩkorwo mũtarĩ ehokeku na indo cia andũ arĩa angĩ-rĩ, nũũ ũngĩmũhe indo cianyu ene?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa wĩgĩĩagĩra na mũtumia nĩegĩagĩra na kĩndũ kĩega, na nĩgũtugwo atugĩtwo nĩ Jehova.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

kikuyu: Arĩa makaahonoka kũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora macooke bũrũri wa Juda moimĩte bũrũri wa Misiri magaakorwo marĩ anini mũno. Hĩndĩ ĩyo matigari mothe ma andũ a Juda arĩa mathiĩte gũtũũra bũrũri wa Misiri, nĩmakamenya nĩ kiugo kĩa ũ gĩkaarũgama: nĩ gĩakwa kana nĩ kĩao.’
english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, anabii aingĩ na athamaki nĩmerirĩirie kuona maũndũ marĩa mũrona, no matiamonire na nĩmerirĩire kũigua maũndũ marĩa mũraigua, no matiamaiguire.” Ngerekano ya Mũsamaria ũrĩa Mwega
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

kikuyu: Wĩhia wa Efiraimu nĩmũige, mehia make nĩmandĩkĩtwo makaigwo.
english: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

kikuyu: Oya Harũni na mũriũ Eleazaru, ũmatware Kĩrĩma-igũrũ kĩa Horu.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũthamaki aiguire ciugo icio cia Watho-rĩ, agĩtembũranga nguo ciake.
english: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ ũhoro ũkoniĩ nyũmba ya ũthamaki ya mũthamaki wa Juda: “O na gũtuĩka ũhaana ta Gileadi harĩ niĩ, ũkahaana ta gacũmbĩrĩ ka Lebanoni, ti-itherũ nĩngatũma ũtuĩke ta werũ ũtarĩ kĩndũ, ũtuĩke ta matũũra matatũũragwo.
english: For Yahweh says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

kikuyu: Ithe wao Efiraimu nĩamacakaĩire mĩthenya mĩingĩ, nao andũ ao magĩũka kũmũhooreria.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

kikuyu: huutha wa Joshua gũkua, andũ a Isiraeli makĩũria Jehova atĩrĩ, “Nĩ a mekwambata mathiĩ mbere magatũhũũranĩre kũrĩ andũ a Kaanani?”
english: fter the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh,† saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

kikuyu: Rũrĩmĩ rwa mũndũ ũrĩa mũũgĩ rũgaathagĩrĩria ũmenyo, no kanua ka mũndũ mũkĩĩgu gathothokaga ũrimũ.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

kikuyu: Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndikwenda mũikare mũrigĩtwo nĩ ũhoro ũyũ wa hitho, nĩgeetha mũtikae kwĩona ta mũrĩ oogĩ: Hitho nĩ atĩ, andũ amwe a Isiraeli nĩanyiite nĩ kũũmia ngoro, o nginya rĩrĩa mũigana wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ ũkaahinga gũtoonya.
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers,† of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

kikuyu: No mwaka- inĩ wa gatatũ, Jehoshafatu mũthamaki wa Juda agĩikũrũka, agĩthiĩ gũceerera mũthamaki wa Isiraeli.
english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

kikuyu: Nao makĩhĩhia nyamũ cia Bathaka mwaki-inĩ, ta ũrĩa gwatuĩtwo, nacio indo cia igongona iria nyamũre igĩtherũkio na nyũngũ, na itengʼũ, o na nyũngũ cia igera, na igĩcooka ikĩgaĩrwo andũ othe o narua.
english: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

kikuyu: Igooka ikĩinainaga ta nyoni ikiuma bũrũri wa Misiri, na ta ndutura ikiuma bũrũri wa Ashuri. Nĩngatũma matũũre mĩciĩ-inĩ yao ene,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. Mehia ma Isiraeli
english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Shobali, ithe wa Kiriathu-Jearimu, ciarĩ: Haroe, na nuthu ya Amanahathi,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa tũmwĩrĩte, o na rĩu nĩ nguuga o rĩngĩ atĩrĩ, mũndũ o wothe angĩmũhunjĩria ũhoro mwega ũngĩ tiga ũrĩa mwetĩkirie-rĩ, aronyiitwo nĩ kĩrumi nginya tene!
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Judasi, ũrĩa wamũkunyanĩire, nĩooĩ handũ hau, nĩ ũndũ Jesũ nĩacemanagĩria ho kaingĩ na arutwo ake.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

kikuyu: “Na nĩngatũma mwĩtĩkĩrĩke nĩ andũ a Misiri, nĩgeetha rĩrĩa mũkoimagara, mũtikanathiĩ moko matheri.
english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩtũmana kũrĩ Jusufu makiuga atĩrĩ, “Thoguo atanakua nĩatigire oiga atĩrĩ:
english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

kikuyu: Ingiuga atĩrĩ, “Ti-itherũ nduma nĩĩkũũhitha, naguo ũtheri ũyũ ũũthiũrũrũkĩirie ũtuĩke ũtukũ,”
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo mwendete o arĩa mamwendete-rĩ, mũgaakĩrĩhwo kĩ? Githĩ o na etia mbeeca cia igooti matiĩkaga o ũguo?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: “ ‘Kana angĩhutia kĩndũ kĩrĩ thaahu kiumĩte harĩ mũndũ, kĩndũ o nakĩ kĩrĩa kĩngĩmũthaahia, o na akorwo ũndũ ũcio ndaũũĩ-rĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa akaaũmenya, nĩagatuĩka nĩahĩtĩtie.
english: “ ‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩamaakinyireharĩakĩrĩndĩkĩarĩ, mũndũũmweagĩthiĩharĩJesũ, akĩmũturĩriandu,
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

kikuyu: Kaĩ atumia arĩa magaakorwo marĩ na nda na arĩa magaakorwo makĩongithia hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmagakorwo marĩ na haaro-ĩ!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Hadadi aakuire, Samala wa kuuma Masereka agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Johana nĩataarire andũ na ciugo nyingĩ na akamahunjagĩria Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,  Isaiah 40:3-5  a tetrarch is one of four governors of a province

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo warĩ bũrũri wa Efiraimu, kũringana na ũrĩa mbarĩ ciao ciatariĩ: mwena wa irathĩro, mũhaka wa igai rĩao woimĩte Atarothu-Adari ũgathiĩ nginya Bethi-Horoni ya Rũgongo,
english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Josia maarĩ: Johanani irigithathi rĩake, nake wa keerĩ aarĩ Jehoiakimu,
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

kikuyu: Aburamu agĩĩtĩkia Jehova. Nake Jehova agĩkenio nĩ wĩtĩkio ũcio, akĩmũtua mũthingu.
english: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

kikuyu: Andũ nĩmakamwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Arĩ harĩa!’ kana ‘Arĩ haha!’ Mũtikanatengʼere mũmarũmĩrĩre.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

kikuyu: “Nĩngũtũma kĩmakania gĩakwa mbere yanyu, na ndũme ndũrĩrĩ iria mũrĩĩkoragĩrĩra inyiitwo nĩ kĩrigiicano. Nĩndĩtũmaga thũ cianyu imũũragĩre.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

kikuyu: Magĩcooka makĩmũtuĩra mata ũthiũ, na makĩmũhũũra na ngundi. Angĩ makĩmũhũũra na hĩ,
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

kikuyu: Mangĩgetĩkĩra na mahingũre ihingo ciao-rĩ, andũ a itũũra rĩu othe magaatuĩka a kũrutithio wĩra na hinya, mamũrutagĩre wĩra.
english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

kikuyu: ũyũ nĩguo ũhoro ũrĩa Jehova aarĩtie wa kũmũũkĩrĩra: “Mũirĩtu Gathirange, Mwarĩ wa Zayuni nĩakũmenete na agakũnyarara. Mwarĩ wa Jerusalemu arainia mũtwe rĩrĩa wee ũroora.
english: this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

kikuyu: “Nake akĩnjũũria atĩrĩ, ‘Wee ũrĩ ũ?’ “Ngĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Niĩ ndĩ Mũamaleki.’
english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa atũmwo maacookire kũrĩ Jakubu makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũrathiire kũrĩ mũrũ wa nyũkwa Esaũ, na rĩu nĩarooka gũgũtũnga, na arĩ na andũ magana mana.”
english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

kikuyu: Ũtungu wa Karia kau waiganaine na rũhĩ† kwarama, naruo rũtiriho † 3:3 nĩ ta mita 27 ‡ 3:3 nĩ ta mita 9; o na mũhari 4, na 8, na 11, na 13 § 3:8 nĩ ta tani 21 * 3:9 nĩ ta nuthu kilo † 3:11 nĩ ta mita igĩrĩ na robo (2.25) ‡ 3:15 nĩ ta mita 16 * 4:1 nĩ ta mita 9 † 4:1 nĩ ta mita inya na nuthu (4:5) ‡ 4:2 nĩ ta mita
english: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.§

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Ezara nĩerutĩire gũthoma na kũrũmia Watho wa Jehova, na kũrutana watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo na mawatho maguo kũu Isiraeli. Marũa ma Mũthamaki Aritashashita kũrĩ Ezara
english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

kikuyu: Igũrũ na thĩ nĩigathira, no ciugo ciakwa itigathira.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

kikuyu: Mwaka ũcio wa mĩrongo ĩtano ũgaatuĩka wa Jubilii kũrĩ inyuĩ; mũtikanahaande na mũtikanagethe kĩrĩa gĩĩkũrĩtie kĩo kĩene, kana mũgethe mĩthabibũ ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ mĩrutĩre wĩra.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

kikuyu: Arata akwa nyenda mũno, ndamũthaitha mũrĩ ta ageni na agendi gũkũ thĩ, mwĩrigagĩrĩrie merirĩria marĩa mooru ma mwĩrĩ, o marĩa marũaga na roho wanyu.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

kikuyu: Baalathu, na Tadimori rĩa werũ-inĩ, thĩinĩ wa bũrũri wake,
english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Thuutha wa maũndũ macio Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, ndungata ya Jehova, agĩkua arĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka igana na ikũmi.
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Asadukai, arĩa moigaga atĩ gũtirĩ ũhoro wa kũriũka magĩũka kũrĩ Jesũ na makĩmũũria atĩrĩ,
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ! Nderi nĩĩkombũka na ĩcuuhũke, ĩtambũrũkĩtie mathagu mayo igũrũ rĩa Bozara. Mũthenya ũcio-rĩ, ngoro cia njamba iria irĩ hinya cia Edomu igaatuĩka ta ngoro ya mũndũ-wa-nja akĩrũmwo. Ndũmĩrĩri ĩkoniĩ Dameski
english: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

kikuyu: No nĩndagirĩrĩirie guoko gwakwa, na ngĩĩka ũndũ, nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa nĩguo rĩtigathaahio maitho-inĩ ma ndũrĩrĩ icio cieyoneire ngĩmaruta kuo.
english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

kikuyu: O na kũrĩ o ro ũguo-rĩ, Jehova Ngai wanyu ndaigana gũthikĩrĩria Balamu, no aagarũrire kĩrumi kĩu gĩgĩtuĩka kĩrathimo harĩ inyuĩ, nĩ ũndũ Jehova Ngai wanyu nĩamwendete.
english: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Moridekai agĩthiĩ na agĩĩka ũrĩa wothe Esiteri aamũtaarĩte.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, thikĩrĩria wega na wĩkĩre ciugo iria ciothe ngũkwarĩria ngoro-inĩ.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ũcio nĩ woni waku, kana nĩ andũ makwĩrĩte ũhoro wakwa?”
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, amwe a aya marũngiĩ haha matigacama gĩkuũ matonete ũthamaki wa Ngai.” Jesũ Kũgarũrũka ũrĩa Aatariĩ
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: nao andũ arĩa maarĩ ahũtu akĩmarehe kuo, nao magĩaka itũũra inene rĩa gũikara.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Jesũ aarĩ kwa Mathayo mũciĩ makĩrĩa irio cia hwaĩ-inĩ, etia mbeeca cia igooti aingĩ na andũ ehia magĩũka kũrĩanĩra hamwe nake na arutwo ake.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

kikuyu: Aathanaga Kĩrĩma kĩa Herimoni, na Saleka, na Bashani guothe, o nginya mũhaka-inĩ wa andũ a Geshuru, na wa Maaka, na nuthu ya Gileadi o nginya mũhaka-inĩ wao na Sihoni mũthamaki wa Heshiboni.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

kikuyu: Ningĩ hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩũgeetana, nake Jehova nĩagagwĩtĩka; nĩũgakaya ũteithio, nake nĩakoiga atĩrĩ: Ĩĩ niĩ ũyũ haha. “Ũngĩeheria icooki rĩa kũhinyanĩrĩria, na weherie kĩara kĩrĩa worotanaga nakĩo, na ndeto cia rũmena-rĩ,
english: Then you will call, and Yahweh will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;

kikuyu: “Tiira maitho wĩrorere mĩena yothe: One ũrĩa andũ othe monganĩte magooka harĩwe, nao ariũ aku makoima kũndũ kũraya, nao airĩtu aku magooka makuuĩtwo na moko.
english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

kikuyu: “No nginya ĩrĩĩagĩrwo thĩinĩ wa nyũmba o ĩmwe, mũtikanoimie nyama o na ĩrĩkũ nja ya nyũmba. Mũtikanoine ihĩndĩ o na rĩmwe rĩayo.
english: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

kikuyu: O ta njagĩ cia werũ, noguo andũ arĩa athĩĩni marokagĩra wĩra wa kũhaara kĩndũ gĩa kũrĩa; kũu bũrũri ũrĩa ũtagĩaga kĩndũ nĩkuo marutaga irio cia kũhe ciana ciao.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

kikuyu: aanjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Paũlũ ndũkae gwĩtigĩra. No nginya ũrũgame mbere ya Kaisari ũciirithio; na rĩrĩ, Ngai tondũ wa wega wake, nĩekũhonokia mĩoyo ya andũ arĩa othe ũrĩ nao.’
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩndamenyire atĩ Alawii matiaheagwo gĩcunjĩ kĩrĩa kĩerĩtwo maaheagwo, na Alawii othe hamwe na aini arĩa maatungataga nĩmatiganĩirie ũtungata, magacooka mĩgũnda-inĩ yao.
english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.

kikuyu: Ririkanaga Mũkũũmbi: mbere ya mũhĩndo wa betha ũtanatuĩka, o na kana mbakũri ya thahabu ĩtaanooragwo; mbere ya ndigithũ gũthethererwo itherũkĩro-inĩ rĩa maaĩ, kana kũgũrũ kwa ngaari kuunĩkĩre gĩthima-inĩ,
english: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,

kikuyu: Nayo hekarũ ĩkĩiyũra ndogo yumĩte riiri-inĩ wa Ngai na thĩinĩ wa hinya wake, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩahotire gũtoonya hekarũ ĩyo nginya mĩthiro ĩyo mũgwanja ya araika acio mũgwanja ĩrĩkĩrĩre.
english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Andũ arĩa agima mĩĩrĩ tio mabataragio nĩ ndagĩtarĩ, no nĩ arĩa arũaru.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu akaamũkinyia bũrũri ũrĩa mũrathiĩ mũkawĩgwatĩre, nĩmũkanĩrĩra ũhoro wa kĩrathimo kĩu kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Gerizimu, nakĩo kĩrumi mũheanĩre ũhoro wakĩo kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Ebali.
english: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

kikuyu: Nĩngumbũra rĩĩtwa rĩaku kũrĩ ariũ a baba; ndĩrĩkũgoocaga ndĩ kĩũngano-inĩ.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

kikuyu: Afilisti magĩikara kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩmwe, nao andũ a Isiraeli magĩikara kĩrĩa kĩngĩ, hagakĩgĩa kĩanda gatagatĩ kao.
english: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the

kikuyu: Jokitani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Alimodadi, na Shelefu, na Hazarimavethu, na Jera,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

kikuyu: Kũrĩ njĩra mũndũ onaga ta yagĩrĩire, no marigĩrĩrio mayo yerekagĩra gĩkuũ-inĩ.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Ta thikĩrĩriai, inyuĩ atongoria a nyũmba ya Jakubu, o inyuĩ aathani a nyũmba ya Isiraeli, inyuĩ mũmenaga kĩhooto, na mũkoogomia maũndũ marĩa ma ma;
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

kikuyu: “Thikĩrĩriai ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova, inyuĩ ndũrĩrĩ; hunjanĩriai ũhoro wayo ndwere-inĩ cia iria kũndũ kũraya, atĩrĩ: ‘We ũrĩa wahurunjire andũ a Isiraeli nĩakamacookereria, na amamenyerere o ta ũrĩa mũrĩithi arĩithagia mbũri cia rũũru rwake.’
english: “Hear Yahweh’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’

kikuyu: Thara kuuma kanua-inĩ ka mĩrũũthi; honokia kuuma hĩa-inĩ cia mbogo.
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, girĩka nĩ ũndũ wa kĩrĩndĩ kĩa bũrũri wa Misiri, na ũkĩharũrũkie kũu thĩ kũriku, hamwe na airĩtu a ndũrĩrĩ iria irĩ hinya, o hamwe na arĩa maikũrũkagio kũu irima-inĩ.
english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: No Aburamu akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Mwathani Jehova, hihi nĩ kĩĩ ũkũũhe, kuona atĩ ndirĩ mwana, na ũrĩa ũkaagaya mũciĩ ũyũ wakwa nĩ Eliezeri wa Dameski?”
english: Abram said, “Lord† Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

kikuyu: Mwathani nĩakahonokia ũũru-inĩ o wothe, na andware ũthamaki-inĩ wake wa igũrũ, nake arogoocagwo tene na tene. Ameni. Ngeithi cia Mũthia
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Mbere ya mwanangĩko, ngoro ya mũndũ ĩkoragwo na mwĩtĩĩo, no kwĩnyiihia nĩkuo gũtongoragia gĩtĩĩo.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

kikuyu: ngai iria ciarĩĩaga maguta ma magongona mao, na ikanyua ndibei ya indo iria ciarutagwo cia kũnyuuo? Reke cigĩũkĩre imũteithie! Reke imũhe kĩĩgitio!
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Dishani maarĩ Uzu, na Arani.
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Joshua akĩhoota mbũtũ cia andũ a Amaleki na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Ũcio nowe ũrĩgoocaga; na nĩwe Ngai waku, ũrĩa wagwĩkĩire maũndũ macio manene na ma kũmakania marĩa weyoneire na maitho maku.
english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

kikuyu: Mũtongoria wa nyũmba cia mbarĩ cia Akohathu aarĩ Elizafani mũrũ wa Uzieli.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

kikuyu: Ageetete ũta wake, akangereka, nduĩke cabaa ya kũrathagwo nĩ mĩguĩ yake.
english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova akĩĩyũria atĩrĩ, “No hithe Iburahĩmu ũrĩa ndĩrenda gwĩka?
english: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

kikuyu: Ũkoiga atĩa rĩrĩa Jehova akaanenehia andũ arĩa watuĩte athiritũ aku nĩguo matuĩke a gũgwathaga? Githĩ ndũkanyiitwo nĩ ruo rũnene, ta rwa mũndũ-wa-nja akĩrũmwo?
english: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

kikuyu: Nake Mũthamaki Solomoni akĩruta igongona rĩa ngʼombe 22,000 na rĩa ngʼondu na mbũri 120,000. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthamaki na andũ othe makĩamũra hekarũ ya Ngai.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

kikuyu: No ũcitware gwacio? Nĩũũĩ tũcĩra twa gũthiĩ kũrĩa itũũraga?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

kikuyu: Ciĩko cia Jehova nĩ cia magegania; nĩicũũranagio nĩ arĩa othe makenagio nĩcio.
english: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo kanua gaku nĩgagatumũka; nĩũkaria nake, na ndũgacooka gũkira. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio wee ũgaatuĩka rũũri harĩo, nao nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.”
english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ-wa-nja o wothe ũrĩa ũhooyaga kana akaratha atahumbĩrĩte mũtwe wake-rĩ, nĩ mũtwe wake aconorithagia, tondũ ũguo no ũndũ ũmwe na kwenjwo.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, gwakĩa aciirithania magĩtũma thigari ikeere mũrangĩri ũcio wa njeera atĩrĩ, “Rekereria andũ acio mathiĩ.”
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

kikuyu: Wee Jehova Ngai wakwa, ndeithia; honokia kũringana na wendo waku.
english: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũcio mũnene agĩtembũranga nguo ciake. Akĩũria atĩrĩ, “Tũgũkĩbatario nĩ aira angĩ a kĩ?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio tũgĩikara kũu gĩtuamba-inĩ hakuhĩ na Bethi-Peori.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, ndongoria na ũthingu waku; nĩ ũndũ wa thũ ciakwa-rĩ, rũngaria njĩra yaku mbere yakwa.
english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

kikuyu: Na ha ũhoro wa Ishumaeli, nĩndakũigua: Ti-itherũ nĩngũmũrathima; nĩngũtũma aciarane, aingĩhe mũno. Nĩagatuĩka ithe wa aathani ikũmi na eerĩ, na nĩngamũtua rũrĩrĩ
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

kikuyu: Nĩngũmũhooya mũmwamũkĩre thĩinĩ wa Mwathani o ta ũrĩa mũngĩamũkĩra andũ arĩa aamũre, na mũmũhe ũteithio o wothe angĩbatario nĩguo kuuma kũrĩ inyuĩ, nĩgũkorwo o nake anakorwo arĩ ũteithio mũnene kũrĩ andũ aingĩ, o hamwe na niĩ mwene.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Mefiboshethu mũrũ wa Jonathani, mũrũ wa Saũlũ, ookire harĩ Daudi, akĩinamĩrĩra amũhe gĩtĩĩo. Nake Daudi akĩmwĩta “Mefiboshethu!” Nake agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Niĩ ũyũ ndungata yaku.”
english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

kikuyu: Magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu mũhuro wa mũcibi ũcio, ĩĩrĩ mwena ũmwe na ĩĩrĩ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ. Mĩrĩnga ĩyo nĩyo yatoonyagio mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraihu yatũmagĩrwo gũgĩkuua.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

kikuyu: Musa akĩũria andũ a Gadi na a Rubeni atĩrĩ, “Andũ anyu no mathiĩ ita-inĩ mamũtige mũikarĩte gũkũ?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ arĩa maatahĩtwo magĩĩka o ta ũrĩa kwerĩtwo. Nake Ezara ũcio mũthĩnjĩri- Ngai agĩthuura arũme arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao, o mũndũ ũmwe kuuma o nyũmba, o ũrĩa ciagayanĩtio, nao othe makĩandĩkwo marĩĩtwa mao. Mũthenya wa mbere wa mweri wa ikũmi magĩikara thĩ nĩguo matuĩrie maciira macio,
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

kikuyu: Ningĩ o ta ũrĩa Jehova Ngai witũ aatwathire-rĩ, nĩtwoimire Horebu, tũgĩthiĩ twerekeire bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Aamori tũtuĩkanĩirie werũ-inĩ ũcio mũnene na wa gwĩtigĩrwo, o ũcio mweyoneire, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio tũgĩkinya Kadeshi-Barinea.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Arũme arĩa othe maathiĩte kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa itũũra rĩu inene magĩĩtĩkania na Hamoru na mũriũ Shekemu, na arũme othe a itũũra rĩu makĩrua.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

kikuyu: nake ũrĩa wothe ũtagakuua mũtharaba wake wa kwambĩrwo aanũmĩrĩre ndagĩrĩire gũtuĩka wakwa.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩeheria ihiga. Jesũ agĩcooka agĩtiira maitho, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Baba, nĩndagũcook- eria ngaatho nĩ ũndũ nĩũnjiguaga.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying.§ Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa akuhĩrĩirie kambĩ, na akĩona njaũ na ndũrũhĩ ĩrĩa yarĩ kũndũ kũu, agĩcinwo nĩ marakara, nake agĩikia ihengere icio thĩ, ikiunĩkanga icunjĩ o hau magũrũ-inĩ ma kĩrĩma.
english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

kikuyu: Mũgaakoragwo o mũkĩrĩa magetha ma mwaka mũthiru nginya rĩrĩa mũkaamaruta nja nĩguo mũgĩe na handũ ha kũiga magetha marĩa maragethwo.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Tambũrũkia guoko ũkũroretie igũrũ matu-inĩ nĩgeetha nduma ĩiyũre bũrũri wa Misiri, nduma ĩngĩhutĩka.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

kikuyu: Nakĩo kiugo kĩa Mwathani gĩkĩhunja kũndũ guothe kũu bũrũri-inĩ.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

kikuyu: Na o hĩndĩ ĩyo Jesũ akĩaragia, hagĩkinya mũndũ woimĩte mũciĩ kwa Jairũ ũrĩa mũnene wa thunagogi, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwarĩguo nĩarĩkĩtie gũkua, tiga gũthĩĩnia Mũrutani.”
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, mũngĩkorwo na wĩtĩkio na mũtigathanganie-rĩ, to ũguo mũkũyũ ũyũ wĩkĩtwo mũngĩhota gwĩka, no rĩrĩ, o na no mũhote kwĩra kĩrĩma gĩkĩ atĩrĩ, ‘Ũrokũũrũka ũikio iria-inĩ,’ na gwĩkĩke ũguo.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

kikuyu: ngĩcooka Jerusalemu. Ndacooka Jerusalemu nĩguo ndaamenyire ũũru ũrĩa Eliashibu eekĩte nĩ ũndũ wa kũhe Tobia kanyũmba nja ya nyũmba ya Ngai.
english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

kikuyu: Na ũndũ ũrĩa wothe mũrĩĩkaga, mũkĩaria kana mũgĩĩka ũndũ, wĩkagei wothe rĩĩtwa-inĩ rĩa Mwathani Jesũ, mũgĩcookagĩria Ngai Ithe witũ ngaatho thĩinĩ wake. Mawatho thĩinĩ wa Mĩciĩ ya Akristiano
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

kikuyu: na thenge ĩmwe ya igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ya kũmũhoroheria mehia.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Kũu njĩra-inĩ andũ nĩ kũrĩra mararĩra nĩ kwaga ndibei, gĩkeno gĩothe gĩtuĩkĩte kĩeha, nacio ikeno ciothe igathira thĩ.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ a Isiraeli maarĩ thĩĩna-inĩ mũnene mũthenya ũcio, nĩ ũndũ Saũlũ nĩamehĩtithĩtie na mwĩhĩtwa, akameera atĩrĩ, “Kũgwatwo nĩ kĩrumi nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũkũrĩa irio gũtanatuka, iterĩhĩirie harĩ thũ ciakwa!” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe wa ita rĩu wacamire irio.
english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio o na inyuĩ no nginya mũikarage mwĩhaarĩirie, tondũ Mũrũ wa Mũndũ agooka ithaa rĩrĩa mũtamwĩrĩgĩrĩire.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
