english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

kikuyu: na kana muuge atĩrĩ, ‘Aca, ithuĩ tũgũthiĩ gũtũũra bũrũri wa Misiri, kũrĩa tũtagacooka kuona mbaara, kana kũigua karumbeta, kana ngʼaragu nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga mũgate,’
english: saying, “No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Solomoni agĩkorwo na gĩathĩ hĩndĩ ĩyo arĩ hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli, maarĩ kĩũngano kĩnene, andũ kuuma Lebo-Hamathu nginya Karũũĩ ka Misiri. Magĩkũngũĩra gĩathĩ kĩu mbere ya Jehova Ngai witũ mĩthenya mũgwanja, na mĩthenya ĩngĩ mũgwanja, yothe yarĩ mĩthenya ikũmi na ĩna.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

kikuyu: maingatithie o ro ũguo na kĩhuhũkanio gĩaku, na ũmamakie mũno na huho ciaku nene.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩatwĩkĩire maũndũ manene, na ithuĩ tũkaiyũrwo nĩ gĩkeno.
english: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

kikuyu: mũtikoomie ngoro cianyu ta ũrĩa mwekire mũrĩ Meriba, o na ta ũrĩa mwekire mũthenya ũrĩa mwarĩ Masa kũu werũ-inĩ,
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

kikuyu: metha na indo ciayo ciothe, na mĩgate ya kũigwo Mbere ya Jehova;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, Jakubu agĩtiira maitho, akĩona Esaũ agĩũka arĩ na andũ ake magana mana; nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩgayania ciana kũrĩ Lea na Rakeli na kũrĩ ndungata iria igĩrĩ cia andũ-a-nja.
english: acob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

kikuyu: “Rĩu-rĩ, mwene mũgũnda ũcio ageeka atĩa? Agooka oorage akombori acio, acooke ahe andũ angĩ mũgũnda ũcio.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kikuyu: Daudi agĩtiga Zadoku ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai hamwe na athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa angĩ hau mbere ya hema ĩrĩa nyamũre,* kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru kũu Gibeoni,
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

kikuyu: Ngaathiiaga ndĩ gatagatĩ kanyu, nduĩke Ngai wanyu, na inyuĩ mũtuĩke andũ akwa.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki nake agĩtũma Jehudi agĩĩre ibuku rĩu rĩa gĩkũnjo, nake Jehudi akĩrĩrehe kuuma kanyũmba-inĩ ka Elishama, ũrĩa mwandĩki, akĩrĩthomera mũthamaki na anene acio othe marũgamĩte hau harĩ mũthamaki.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, ũmũthĩ ũyũ tũrĩ ngombo, ngombo bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩa waheire maithe maitũ ma tene nĩguo marĩĩage matunda maguo na indo iria ingĩ njega ikũraga kuo.
english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

kikuyu: Nĩatige kwĩheenia na ũndũ wa kwĩhoka maũndũ ma tũhũ, nĩgũkorwo gũtirĩ kĩndũ makaamũrehere.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Benjamini, aarĩ Paliti mũrũ wa Rafu;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũthamaki agĩtũmĩra Elija mũnene ũngĩ wa thigari arĩ na andũ ake mĩrongo ĩtano. Nake mũnene ũcio akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee mũndũ wa Ngai, mũthamaki ekuuga atĩrĩ, ‘Ikũrũka narua!’ ”
english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’ ”

kikuyu: Nake Labani akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩndetĩkĩra; reke gũtuĩke o ro ũguo woiga.”
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũngĩ wa Thabatũ nĩathiire thunagogi-inĩ, akĩrutana, nakuo nĩ kwarĩ na mũndũ warĩ mwonju guoko gwake kwa ũrĩo.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, ndũgamĩte mũrango-inĩ ngĩũringaringa. Mũndũ o wothe angĩigua mũgambo wakwa, na ahingũre mũrango, nĩngũtoonya thĩinĩ ndĩĩanĩre irio nake, nake arĩĩanĩre na niĩ.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

kikuyu: We na mbũtũ ciake cia ita, o mbũtũ icio ikĩrĩtie ndũrĩrĩ iria ingĩ ciothe kwaga tha, nĩcio ikaarehwo, iniine bũrũri ũcio. Nĩigacomora hiũ ciao cia njora, ciũkĩrĩre bũrũri wa Misiri na ciyũrie bũrũri ũcio andũ arĩa moragĩtwo.
english: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

kikuyu: No wee no ũkiuge atĩrĩ, “Honge icio ciakahũrirwo nĩgeetha njiarithanio na mũtĩ.”
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

kikuyu: Ndeerire itũũra rĩu inene atĩrĩ, ‘Ti-itherũ nĩũkanjĩtigĩra, na wĩtĩkĩre gũtaarwo!’ Hĩndĩ ĩyo itũũro ciake itikaniinwo, o na kana maherithia makwa mamũkore.” No o meeriragĩria o gwĩka ũũru maũndũ-inĩ mao mothe.
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa maaragia maheeni nĩũmaniinaga; nao arĩa maitaga thakame na makaheenania, Jehova nĩamathũire.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Joshua agĩcina Ai na akĩrĩtua hĩba ya mwanangĩko ya gũtũũra, gũgĩtuĩka kũndũ gũkirĩte ihooru nginya ũmũthĩ.
english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, gũtirĩ ũngĩ ũtariĩ tawe, Wee Jehova; Wee ũrĩ mũnene, narĩo rĩĩtwa rĩaku nĩ rĩrĩ ũhoti mũnene.
english: There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.

kikuyu: “Nĩmũgaconoka nĩ ũndũ wa mĩgandi ĩyo mĩamũre mũtũire mũkenagĩra; nĩmũkaigua thoni nĩ ũndũ wa mĩgũnda ĩyo mwĩthuurĩire.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Maheei kĩndũ gĩa kũrĩa.” Nao makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Tũrĩ o na mĩgate ĩtano na thamaki igĩrĩ, no tũthiire tũkagũrĩre andũ aya othe irio.”
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

kikuyu: Haha nĩhabataire ũkirĩrĩria harĩ andũ arĩa aamũre, o arĩa maathĩkagĩra Maathani ma Ngai, na magatũũra marĩ ehokeku harĩ Jesũ.
english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩũrĩra andũ a Isiraeli marorete na werũ-inĩ, no matingĩahotire kũũrĩra mbaara. Nao andũ a Isiraeli arĩa mookire moimĩte matũũra-inĩ makĩmoor- agĩra kuo.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

kikuyu: “Ti-itherũ nĩnjiguĩte mũcaayo wa Efiraimu akiuga atĩrĩ: ‘Wee nĩũũherithĩtie o ta gacaũ gatamenyerete gwĩkĩrwo icooki, na niĩ nĩnjathĩkĩte. Njokereria, na niĩ nĩngũcooka, tondũ wee nĩwe Jehova Ngai wakwa.
english: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me, and I will be turned, for you are Yahweh my God.

kikuyu: Ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova nĩyanginyĩrire, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ndĩraarĩria andũ oogĩ; mwĩkũũranĩrei ũrĩa ndĩroiga.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

kikuyu: Na no-o matoonyagĩrĩra nyũmba cia atumia a ndigwa makamatunya indo ciao, na nĩguo meyonanie, makahooya mahooya maraihu. Andũ ta acio nĩ makaaherithio mũno makĩria.” Iruta rĩa Mũtumia wa Ndigwa
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo nacio ndũrĩrĩ ciothe cia gũkũ thĩ nĩcikoona atĩ wĩtanĩtio na rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova, nacio nĩigagwĩtigĩra.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa Musa ndungata ya Jehova aathĩte andũ a Isiraeli. Aagĩakire o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo thĩinĩ wa Ibuku rĩa Watho wa Musa, kĩgongona kĩrĩ kĩa mahiga matarĩ maicũhie, hatarĩ indo cia wĩra cia kĩgera ikũhũthĩrwo ho. Igũrũ rĩakĩo makĩrutĩra Jehova maruta ma njino na magongona ma ũiguano.
english: as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted up any iron. They offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ acio maatũmĩtwo maacookire kũrĩ mũthamaki, akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũma mũcooke?”
english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

kikuyu: Abimeleku agĩthiĩ mũthiringo-inĩ ũcio, akĩũhithũkĩra. No rĩrĩa akuhĩrĩirie itoonyero rĩa mũthiringo nĩguo aũgwatie mwaki-rĩ,
english: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakaminjĩria mũndũ ũcio ũratherio mũrimũ ũcio ũngĩgwatanio thakame ĩyo maita mũgwanja, na acooke oige atĩ mũndũ ũcio ndarĩ na thaahu. Ningĩ acooke arekererie nyoni ĩyo ĩngĩ ĩrĩ muoyo yũmbũke ĩthiĩ werũ-inĩ.
english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

kikuyu: O na kũrĩ ũguo-rĩ, aingĩ ao matiigana gũkenia Ngai; nacio ciimba ciao ikĩhurunjwo werũ-inĩ.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

kikuyu: No ha ũhoro wa ciana cianyu iria mwoigire atĩ nĩ igaatahwo-rĩ, nĩngamakinyia kuo makenagĩre bũrũri ũcio mũregete.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

kikuyu: O nao andũ acio maatuĩtwo Arefai, o ta Anaki, no andũ a Moabi maameetaga Aemi.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Moherere ngoro-inĩ yaku nginya tene; makundĩke marigiicĩrie ngingo yaku.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

kikuyu: Nĩũkũingatwo weherio kuuma kũrĩ andũ, ũgatũũranagie na nyamũ cia gĩthaka; ũrĩrĩĩaga nyeki ta ngʼombe. Mĩaka mũgwanja nĩĩgũthira, o nginya ũmenye atĩ, Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno nĩwe ũthamakagĩra mothamaki mothe ma andũ, na akamaheana kũrĩ o ũrĩa angĩenda.”
english: You shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like oxen. Seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.’ ”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio roho wakwa ũkaringĩka thĩinĩ wakwa; ngoro yakwa nĩĩmakĩte mũno thĩinĩ wakwa.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte nguo ciaku itunĩhe, ta cia mũndũ ũraranga kĩhihĩro kĩa ndibei?
english: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

kikuyu: Anene ake o nao nĩmarutĩire andũ, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai, o na Alawii indo meyendeire. Hilikia, na Zekaria, na Jehieli, arĩa maarĩ arũgamĩrĩri a hekarũ ya Ngai, nĩmaheire athĩnjĩri-Ngai indo 2,600 cia maruta ma Bathaka, na ngʼombe 300.
english: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

kikuyu: O we wiki nĩwe rwaro rwakwa rwa ihiga na ũhonokio wakwa; nĩwe kĩirigo gĩakwa kĩa hinya ndirĩ hĩndĩ ngenyenyeka.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, kamwana gaka kangĩaga gũthiĩ na niĩ tũgacooka kũrĩ ndungata yaku ũcio baba, o baba ũcio muoyo wake wohanĩtio na muoyo wa kamwana gaka-rĩ,
english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

kikuyu: ndaciarirwo irĩma itanahaandwo harĩa irĩ, na tũrĩma tũtanagĩa,
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

kikuyu: na gategwa kamwe, na ndũrũme ĩmwe, na gatũrũme ka mwaka ũmwe, nĩ ũndũ wa iruta rĩa njino;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo ũndũ ũrĩa wathĩrĩirio arĩa meĩhokaga o ene, na arũmĩrĩri ao, arĩa metĩkanagia na mĩario yao.
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

kikuyu: Thũ ciao ikĩmahinyĩrĩria, na ikĩmaiga rungu rwa wathani wao.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

kikuyu: No nginya onanie atĩ mũriũ ũcio wa mũtumia ũcio atendete nĩwe irigithathi na ũndũ wa kũmũhe indo maita meerĩ thĩinĩ wa indo iria ciothe arĩ nacio. Mũriũ ũcio nĩwe kĩonereria kĩa mbere kĩa hinya wa ithe. Kĩhooto kĩa mwana wa irigithathi nĩ gĩake. Mwana ũrĩa Mũremi
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

kikuyu: Nathani akĩũria atĩrĩ, “Wee mũthamaki mwathi wakwa-rĩ, nĩũtuĩte atĩ Adonija nĩwe ũgaatuĩka mũthamaki thuutha waku, na atĩ nĩwe ũgaikarĩra gĩtĩ gĩaku kĩa ũnene?
english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

kikuyu: Nĩatũmĩte magegania make maririkanwo; Jehova nĩ mũtugi na nĩ mũigua tha.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

kikuyu: Mĩthenya ĩtatũ ĩtanathira-rĩ, Firaũni nĩagagũtinithia mũtwe na akwambithie mũtĩ igũrũ. Nacio nyoni nĩikarĩa nyama cia mwĩrĩ waku.”
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ Joshua akĩhũndũka na agĩtunyana itũũra rĩa Hazoru na akĩũraga mũthamaki warĩo na rũhiũ rwa njora. (Hazoru nĩrĩo rĩarĩ itũũra inene mothamaki-inĩ macio).
english: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

kikuyu: nake akĩmũkunyĩra ũhoro, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Baba Saũlũ nĩaracaria mweke wa gũkũũraga. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũkemenyerera rũciũ rũciinĩ; ũthiĩ wĩhithe handũ, na ũikare ho.
english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa wĩkaga ũũru nĩakarĩhwo kũringana na ũũru wake, na gũtirĩ gũtĩĩra mũndũ maũthĩ.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

kikuyu: Kĩu nĩkĩo gĩtũmĩte njũũrie tuonane na inyuĩ na twaranĩrie. Njohetwo na mũnyororo ũyũ nĩ ũndũ wa kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro kĩa andũ a Isiraeli.”
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ ũgacooka * 18:1 Shilo nĩkuo gwatuĩkire itũũra rĩa maũndũ ma thirikari na ma ndini ma andũ a Isiraeli. Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo yaikarire kũu nginya hĩndĩ ya Samũeli (1Sam 1–11) mbere ya gũthaamĩrio Gibeoni (1Maũ 21:29).
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

kikuyu: Nake Firaũni agĩĩta Musa na Harũni, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ihinda rĩĩrĩ nĩnjĩhĩtie. Jehova nĩwe wa ma; niĩ na andũ akwa nĩtũhĩtĩtie.
english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

kikuyu: Aca, ngoro-inĩ cianyu mũthugundaga maũndũ matarĩ ma kĩhooto,
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

kikuyu: Nao oohwo arĩa marainaina nĩ guoya nĩmekuohorwo o narua; matigakuĩra kũu marima-inĩ ma njeera, o na kana irio ciao ciage.
english: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.

kikuyu: Jehova Ngai witũ nĩarĩĩkanĩire kĩrĩkanĩro na ithuĩ kũu Horebu.
english: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

kikuyu: Ndũkanagerere njĩra ya andũ arĩa aaganu, kana ũthiĩre njĩra ya andũ arĩa ooru.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ Tito, gĩtũmi kĩrĩa gĩatũmire ngũtige kũu Kirete nĩ atĩ ũthondeke maũndũ marĩa mataarĩkĩte na ũthuure athuuri thĩinĩ wa o itũũra, o ta ũrĩa ndakwĩrire.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

kikuyu: nĩtwĩhĩtie na tũgeka ũũru. Nĩtũkoretwo tũrĩ aaganu na tũkarema, tũkahutatĩra maathani maku na mawatho maku.
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

kikuyu: maarĩonire, magĩtuĩka nda; makĩũra nĩ kĩmako kĩnene.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

kikuyu: nake Meraiothu aarĩ mũriũ wa Zerahia, nake Amaria aarĩ mũriũ wa Meraiothu, nake Ahitubu aarĩ mũriũ wa Amaria,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa Juda nĩgũkoima ũrĩa ũgaatuĩka ihiga rĩa koine, na kuuma kũrĩ we kuume higĩ cia kwamba hema, ningĩ kuume ũta wa mbaara, o na kuume mũndũ o wothe wa gwathana.
english: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

kikuyu: o nake Ahinadabu mũrũ wa Ido akarũgamĩrĩra Mahanaimu;
english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

kikuyu: Nake akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, nĩũrona maũndũ maya? Nĩũkuona maũndũ o na marĩ magigi mũno gũkĩra maya.”
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

kikuyu: Nake akĩhũmũka ihũmũka inene, akĩũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩkĩ gĩgũtũma rũciarorũrũrũũrierũringĩrwokĩama? Ngũmwĩraatĩrĩnamagũtirĩkĩamarũkũringĩrwo.”
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation† seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

kikuyu: Mikaya agĩthiĩ na mbere, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio thikĩrĩria kiugo kĩa Jehova: Ndĩronire Jehova aikarĩire gĩtĩ gĩake kĩa ũnene arĩ na mbũtũ yothe ya igũrũ ĩrũgamĩte ĩmũthiũrũkĩirie mwena wa ũrĩo na wa ũmotho.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, wendani waku ũkinyĩte o igũrũ, naguo wĩhokeku waku ũgakinya o matu-inĩ.
english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Zerubabeli o na kũrĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia andũ, makĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Rekei twake tũrĩ hamwe tondũ o na ithuĩ tũrongoragia Ngai wanyu, na nĩtũkoretwo tũkĩmũrutĩra magongona kuuma hĩndĩ ya Esari-Hadoni mũthamaki wa Ashuri, ũrĩa watũrehire gũkũ.”*
english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

kikuyu: Mũndũ wa Ngai agĩũka, akĩĩra mũthamaki wa Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Jehova ekuuga ũũ: ‘Tondũ Asuriata mareciiria Jehova nĩ ngai wa irĩma-inĩ na ti ngai wa ituamba-inĩ-rĩ, nĩngũneana mbũtũ ĩno nene ũũ moko-inĩ maku, nawe ũmenye atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.’ ”
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.’ ”

kikuyu: Nake mũraika wa mbere agĩthiĩ akĩonoreria mbakũri yake thĩ, nacio ironda njũru mũno irĩ ruo ikĩgĩa andũ arĩa maarĩ na rũũri rwa nyamũ ĩyo, na arĩa maahooyaga mũhiano wayo.
english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, haarĩ na rũũru rũnene rwa ngũrwe rwarĩĩaga harũrũka-inĩ cia kĩrĩma kĩarĩ hakuhĩ na hau.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩrathima Jusufu, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ngai ũrĩa maithe makwa Iburahĩmu na Isaaka maatungatagĩra, Ngai ũrĩa ũkoretwo arĩ mũrĩithi wakwa mũtũũrĩre-inĩ wakwa wothe nginya ũmũthĩ,
english: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

kikuyu: Arĩ nda ya nyina nĩanyiitire ndiira ya mũrũ wa nyina; aatuĩka mũndũ mũgima-rĩ, nĩagianire na Ngai.
english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended

kikuyu: Ikĩambĩrĩria kũmũnyũrũria, ikĩmwĩraga atĩrĩ, “Ũkĩrĩ mũhoro, wee mũthamaki wa Ayahudi?”
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Nake mũthamaki akĩĩhĩta, akiuga atĩrĩ: “O ta ũrĩa Jehova atũũraga muoyo, ũrĩa wanaahonokia kuuma mathĩĩna-inĩ mothe,
english: The king vowed and said, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

kikuyu: “No mũngĩkaaga gwĩka ũguo, nĩmũkehĩria Jehova; na mũmenye na ma atĩ mehia manyu nĩmakamũcookerera.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

kikuyu: ũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũrũmbũyagia andũ arĩa matarĩ hinya; ũcio-rĩ, Jehova nĩamũhatũraga hĩndĩ ya mathĩĩna.
english: lessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

kikuyu: o rĩrĩ, andũ a bũrũri ũyũ arĩa makoretwo marĩ na mĩnyamaro matigacooka kũgĩa na kĩeha. Mbere ĩyo nĩanyararithirie bũrũri wa Zebuluni na bũrũri wa Nafitali, no mahinda ma thuutha-inĩ nĩagatĩĩithia bũrũri ũrĩa ũgereire iria-inĩ, ũikũrũkanĩtie na Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani, nĩkuo gwĩtagwo Galili- kwa-Ndũrĩrĩ:
english: ut there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

kikuyu: Thuutha-inĩ, ta ũrĩa mũũĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa eendire kũgaya kĩrathimo gĩake, nĩaregirwo. Ndaahotire kuona kamweke ga kwĩrira, o na gwatuĩka nĩacaririe kĩrathimo kĩu na maithori.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

kikuyu: No nginya mũkũũranage indo iria nyamũre na iria itarĩ nyamũre, o na iria irĩ thaahu na iria itarĩ thaahu,
english: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩona njaũ ya ndigiri, akĩmĩikarĩra, o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo aaririe, akĩarahũra kĩhuhũkanio kĩrĩa gĩatũmire iria rĩgĩe na makũmbĩ.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

kikuyu: Nake nĩathaga athamaki othe kuuma Rũũĩ rwa Farati nginya bũrũri wa Afilisti, o nginya mũhaka-inĩ wa bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kũrĩ maũndũ matandatũ mathũirwo nĩ Jehova, ĩĩ, o na nĩ mũgwanja marĩa onaga marĩ magigi, nĩmo:
english: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kikuyu: Ũtonga nĩwongagĩrĩra mũndũ arata aingĩ, no mũndũ mũthĩĩni nĩeheragĩrwo nĩ mũratawe.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova nĩagakũhurunja ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ ciothe, kuuma gĩturi kĩmwe gĩa thĩ nginya kĩrĩa kĩngĩ. Ũrĩ kũu ũkaahooyaga ngai ingĩ, ngai cia mĩtĩ na cia mahiga, iria wee o na maithe manyu mũtooĩ.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩtũgĩtige gũtuanĩra ciira ithuĩ ene. Handũ ha ũguo-rĩ, kaba mũtue na meciiria manyu atĩ mũtigatũma mũrũ kana mwarĩ wa ithe wanyu ahĩngwo kana agwe njĩra-inĩ.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

kikuyu: Matigaitĩra Jehova maruta ma ndibei, kana magongona mao mamũkenie. Kũrĩo magongona ta macio makaahaana ta mũgate wa andũ megũcakaya; arĩa othe makaamarĩa nĩmakanyiitwo nĩ thaahu. Irio icio igaakorwo irĩ ciao o ene; itikareehwo hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova.
english: They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Nĩngamarehithĩria rũhiũ rwa njora, na ngʼaragu, na mũthiro imokĩrĩre, nginya maniinwo mathire bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩa ndaamaheire o na ngĩhe maithe mao.’ ”
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’ ”

kikuyu: No Ngai aandũmire mbere yanyu nĩguo ndũme matigari manyu matũũre gũkũ thĩ, na honokie mĩoyo yanyu na kũhonokania kũnene.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ, “Ha ũhoro wakwa-rĩ, gĩkĩ nĩkĩo kĩrĩkanĩro kĩrĩa ndarĩkanĩire nao, atĩ Roho wakwa, ũrĩa ũrĩ igũrũ rĩaku, na ciugo ciakwa iria njĩkĩrĩte kanua gaku, itirĩ hĩndĩ ikehera kuuma kanua gaku, kana ciehere kuuma tũnua twa ciana ciaku, o na kana ciehere kuuma tũnua twa njiaro ciao, kuuma rĩu nginya tene na tene,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says Yahweh, “from now on and forever.”

kikuyu: Kuuma tũcũmbĩrĩ twa ndwaro cia mahiga nĩndĩramoona, kuuma kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru nĩndĩramoona. Ndĩrona andũ matũũraga meikarĩtie, nao matiĩtaraga atĩ o nĩ amwe a ndũrĩrĩ.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone,

kikuyu: na andũ a Jeriko maarĩ 345
english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

kikuyu: aikia a mĩguĩ ake nĩmandigiicĩirie. Aratheeca higo ciakwa atarĩ na tha, na agaita maaĩ makwa ma nyongo thĩ.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

kikuyu: Na inyuĩ-rĩ, maguta marĩa mwahakirwo nĩwe-rĩ, megũtũũra thĩinĩ wanyu, na mũtibatairio nĩ mũndũ o na ũ wa kũmũruta ũhoro. No rĩrĩ, o ta ũrĩa ihaka rĩake rĩa maguta rĩmũrutaga ũhoro wa maũndũ mothe, na o ta ũrĩa rĩrĩ rĩa ma, na ti rĩa maheeni: o ta ũrĩa rĩmũrutĩĩte-rĩ, tũũrai thĩinĩ wake. Ciana cia Ngai
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

kikuyu: a rĩrĩ, ũtukũ ũcio mũthamaki akĩũrwo nĩ toro; nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩathana areherwo ibuku rĩrĩa rĩandĩkĩtwo maũndũ ma matukũ ma tene, maandĩko marĩa ma wathani wake, rĩrehwo athomerwo.
english: n that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

kikuyu: Mangʼũrĩ ma mũthamaki nĩ ta mũraramo wa mũrũũthi; ũrĩa ũmũrakaragia nĩ muoyo wake ateaga.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of

kikuyu: nake Jesũ akĩhonia andũ aingĩ arĩa maarĩ na mĩrimũ mĩthemba mĩingĩ. Ningĩ akĩingata ndaimono nyingĩ, no ndetĩkĩririe ndaimono ciarie tondũ nĩciamũũĩ. Jesũ Kũhooya arĩ Handũ Keheri-inĩ
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

kikuyu: Maaĩ macio makĩambatĩra mũno igũrũ wa thĩ, nacio irĩma ciothe iria ndaaya na igũrũ gũkũ mũhuro wa matu guothe ikĩhumbĩrwo nĩmo.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maatwarĩire Jesũ njaũ ĩyo, makĩmĩtandĩka nguo ciao nake Jesũ agĩkuuo nĩyo.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

kikuyu: “Ũrĩa wothe ũkoora nĩ ũndũ wa guoya, ũcio akaagũa irima, nake ũrĩa ũkaahaica oime irima-rĩ, akaagwatio nĩ mũtego; nĩ ũndũ nĩngũtũma Moabi akinyĩrwo nĩ mwaka wa kũherithio,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Makĩmuoha na mĩnyororo; makĩmũruta kũu, makĩmũtwara kũrĩ Pilato, ũrĩa warĩ barũthi.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

kikuyu: Nao atũũri a gĩcigĩrĩra kĩu magĩtuonia ũtugi wa mwanya. Magĩtwakĩria mwaki tondũ nĩ kuoiraga na kwarĩ na heho na magĩtũnyiita ũgeni ithuothe.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

kikuyu: Nowe Zakayo akĩrũgama, akĩĩra Mwathani atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, rĩu nĩngũheana nuthu ya indo ciakwa kũrĩ athĩĩni, na hangĩkorwo harĩ mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ndunyĩte kĩndũ, nĩngũmũrĩha kĩndũ kĩu maita mana.”
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

kikuyu: nĩguo maciire ũrĩa mangĩnyiitithia Jesũ na njĩra ya wara, na mamũũragithie.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

kikuyu: ingĩ Mũthamaki Daudi akĩĩra kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe atĩrĩ: “Mũriũ wakwa Solomoni, ũrĩa Ngai athuurĩte, nĩ mwĩthĩ na ndarĩ na ũmenyo wa kũigana. Wĩra ũyũ nĩ mũnene, tondũ nyũmba ĩno ĩhaana ta ya ũthamaki ti ya mũndũ no nĩ ya Jehova Ngai.
english: avid the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

kikuyu: Mwathani Jehova ekũũria atĩrĩ: Anga niĩ nĩngenagio nĩ gĩkuũ kĩa andũ arĩa aaganu? Githĩ ti kwenda ingĩenda magarũrũke matigane na mĩthiĩre ĩyo yao nĩguo matũũre muoyo?
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

kikuyu: O na ningĩ Musa akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Nĩmũkamenya atĩ ũcio nĩ Jehova, rĩrĩa akaamũhe nyama mũrĩe hwaĩ-inĩ na amũhe mĩgate ĩrĩa yothe mũkwenda rũciinĩ, tondũ nĩaiguĩte ũrĩa mũmũtetetie. Ithuĩ tũkĩrĩ a? Ti ithuĩ mũratetia, no nĩ Jehova mũratetia.”
english: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Thaama uume bũrũri wanyu na ũtige andũ anyu, ũthiĩ bũrũri ũrĩa ngaakuonia.’
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’*

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũndũ o wothe ũngĩhutia mũndũ ũcio ũroira no nginya athambie nguo ciake na ethambe na maaĩ, na atiinde arĩ na thaahu o nginya hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: “ ‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maaiguire ũguo, makĩngʼũrĩka mũno na makĩanĩrĩra, makiugaga atĩrĩ: “Aritemi wa Aefeso nĩ mũnene!”
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

kikuyu: Ningĩ andũ matiĩkagĩra ndibei ya mũhihano mondo-inĩ ngũrũ.* Mangĩĩka ũguo, mondo icio no itarũke, nayo ndibei ĩitĩke, na mondo icio cia ndibei cianangĩke o biũ. No andũ mekagĩra ndibei ya mũhihano mondo-inĩ njerũ, nacio cierĩ igaikara irĩ njega.” Mũirĩtu Wakuĩte na Mũtumia warĩ Mũrũaru
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

kikuyu: Itĩrĩriai Moabi cumbĩ, tondũ nĩrĩkonũhwo; matũũra makuo nĩmagakira ihooru, kwage mũndũ o na ũmwe ũngĩmatũũra.
english: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Wee nĩwe wandutire nda ya maitũ; watũmire ngwĩhoke ndĩ o nyondo-inĩ cia maitũ.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

kikuyu: Shaitani agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ Ayubu agĩĩtigagĩra Ngai o ro ũguo tũhũ?
english: Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio andũ a Benjamini makĩona atĩ nĩmaatooretio. Na rĩrĩ, andũ a Isiraeli nĩmoorĩire andũ a Benjamini, nĩ ũndũ nĩmehokete andũ arĩa maigĩte a kuoheria andũ a Benjamini gũkuhĩ na Gibea.
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa aahuraga mbeũ icio-rĩ, imwe ikĩgũa mũkĩra-inĩ wa njĩra, nacio nyoni igĩũka ĩgĩcirĩa.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

kikuyu: Inainai mũrĩ mbere yake, inyuĩ andũ a thĩ yothe! Thĩ ĩhaandĩtwo ĩkarũma; ndĩngĩenyenyeka.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Nake Balaki agĩcinwo nĩ marakara nĩ ũndũ wa Balamu. Akĩhũũra hĩ ciake, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndagwĩtire ũnumĩre thũ ciakwa, no wee ũcirathimĩte maita macio matatũ.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

kikuyu: Moabi nĩ kĩraĩ gĩakwa gĩa gwĩthambĩra, na Edomu nĩho njikagia kĩraatũ gĩakwa; nĩngwanĩrĩra nĩ ũrĩa ndooretie bũrũri wa Filistia.”
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũthamaki wa Sodomu, na mũthamaki wa Gomora, na mũthamaki wa Adima, na mũthamaki wa Zeboimu, na mũthamaki wa Bela (na nokuo Zoari) magĩthiĩ makĩhaarĩria ita rĩao rĩa mbaara o kũu Gĩtuamba-inĩ gĩa Sidimu,
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

kikuyu: Na maciaro macio maarĩkia kũũma, mũrĩmi ũcio akoya rũhiũ rwa igetha, akagetha tondũ hĩndĩ ya magetha nĩ yakinya.” Ngerekano ya Mbeũ ya Karatarĩ
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

kikuyu: Ndungata ciaku irokĩonio ciĩko ciaku, naguo riiri waku wonio ciana ciao.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo acio nĩ anabii marĩ na ndũmĩrĩri kuuma kũrĩ Jehova-rĩ, nĩmagĩthaitheJehovaMwene-Hinya-WothenĩguoindoiriaitigarĩtegũkũthĩinĩwanyũmbayaJehova, o na thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya mũthamaki wa Juda, o na kũu Jerusalemu itigatwarwo Babuloni.
english: But if they are prophets, and if Yahweh’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to Yahweh of Armies, that the vessels which are left in Yahweh’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩĩguna nakĩ angĩĩgwatĩra thĩ yothe, no orwo nĩ muoyo wake?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

kikuyu: Mũthamaki agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Aca, mũrũ wakwa. Tũtiagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũthiĩ ithuothe; twahota gũtuĩka mũrigo harĩwe.” O na gũtuĩka Abisalomu nĩamũthaithire-rĩ, nĩaregire biũ gũthiĩ, no akĩmũhe kĩrathimo gĩake.
english: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

kikuyu: Nĩ maita maingĩ atĩa maamũremagĩra marĩ kũu werũ-inĩ, na makamũiguithia kĩeha marĩ kũu rũngʼũrĩ-inĩ.
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩcookeria arĩa maatũmĩtwo atĩrĩ, “Cookai mũkeere Johana maũndũ marĩa muonete na mũkaigua: atĩ atumumu nĩ marona, na ithua nĩiretwara, na arĩa marĩ na mangũ nĩ marahonio, na andũ arĩa mataiguaga nĩmaraigua, na arĩa akuũ nĩmarariũkio, na Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega nĩũrahunjĩrio arĩa athĩĩni.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Tiga nĩ ũguo-rĩ, ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli, atũũraga muoyo, ũcio ũgiririe ngũgere ngero, korwo ndũnooka na ihenya kũndũnga-rĩ, gũtirĩ mũndũ mũrũme o na ũmwe ũkoniĩ Nabali ũngĩakorwo arĩ muoyo gũgĩkĩa.”
english: For indeed, as Yahweh the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”†

kikuyu: O makĩaragia ũhoro ũcio, Jesũ akĩrũgama gatagatĩ kao akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Thayũ ũrogĩa na inyuĩ.”
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa twathagwo nĩ mwĩrĩ ũyũ wa mehia-rĩ, merirĩria ma mehia marĩa maarahũragwo nĩ watho nĩmarutaga wĩra thĩinĩ wa mĩĩrĩ iitũ, magaciaragĩra gĩkuũ maciaro.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩgũkorwo nĩngamũruta ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ icio; nĩngamũcookanĩrĩria kuuma mabũrũri macio mothe, na ndĩmũcookie bũrũri wanyu kĩũmbe.
english: “ ‘ “For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

kikuyu: tongoria a nyũmba cia mbarĩ ya Gileadi mũrũ wa Makiru, mũrũ wa Manase, arĩa maarĩ a mbarĩ cia njiaro cia Jusufu, nĩmathiire na makĩaria marĩ mbere ya Musa na atongoria arĩa matongoragia nyũmba cia andũ a Isiraeli.
english: he heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ndakwĩra atĩrĩ na ma ndĩ mbere ya Ngai, na Kristũ Jesũ o na araika arĩa athuure, ũmenyagĩrĩre morutani maya ũtegũthutũkania, na ndũkaneeke ũndũ o na ũmwe na kĩmenyano.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

kikuyu: Nao andũ arĩa maamohetie makiuma itũũra rĩu inene matharĩkĩre. Andũ a Ai magĩgĩĩkĩrwo gatagatĩ ka andũ a Isiraeli, makĩmagĩa mbere na thuutha. Andũ a Isiraeli makĩmaniina, na matiatigirie mũndũ o na ũmwe arĩ muoyo, kana makĩreka o na ũmwe ahonoke.
english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

kikuyu: ee Jehova, ũkũrũgama haraaya nĩkĩ? Wĩhithaga nĩkĩ hĩndĩ ya mathĩĩna?
english: hy do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

kikuyu: na Bethi-Lebaothu, na Sharuheni; mothe maarĩ matũũra ikũmi na matatũ na tũtũũra twamo.
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

kikuyu: Marigĩrĩrio-inĩ roho ũmwe ũkiumĩra, ũkĩrũgama mbere ya Jehova, ũkiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩ niĩ ngũmũheenereria.’
english: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

kikuyu: Nĩngũcookeria Ngai ngaatho, ũrĩa wekĩrire ngoro-inĩ ya Tito ũhoro wa kũmũrũmbũiya o ta ũrĩa niĩ ndĩ na ũhoro ũcio.
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

kikuyu: Nyondo ĩrĩa ĩtũũrĩte ĩhũũraga thĩ yothe-rĩ, kaĩ nĩyunangĩtwo, ĩgathethereka-ĩ! Kaĩ Babuloni nĩgũkirĩte ihooru gatagatĩ-inĩ ka ndũrĩrĩ-ĩ!
english: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

kikuyu: no andũ a gũkũ thĩ no nginya mamenye atĩ nĩnyendete Baba, na atĩ njĩkaga o ũrĩa Baba anjathĩte. “Ũkai rĩu; nĩtũthiĩi.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩtũma ndungata ĩngĩ, ĩyo o nayo makĩmĩhũũra makĩmĩconorithia na makĩmĩingata ĩtarĩ na kĩndũ.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Ndigacooka gũtũma mũigue kĩnyũrũri kĩa ndũrĩrĩ, o na kana mũcooke kũnyararwo nĩ kĩrĩndĩ, kana ndũme rũrĩrĩ rwanyu rũgwe, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.’ ”
english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’ ”

kikuyu: Atwari acio a marũa, mahaicĩte mbarathi cia mũthamaki, magĩthiĩ na ihenya nĩkũhĩkwo nĩ watho wa mũthamaki. Narĩo itua rĩu nĩrĩaheanirwo kũu nyũmba-inĩ ya mũthamaki kũu Shushani.
english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

kikuyu: Mũneneũcionĩweũkaarutagamarutamanjino, namarutamamũtu, namarutamakũnyuuociathĩ- inĩ, na Tũrũgamo twa Mweri, na Thabatũ, o na ciathĩ-inĩ ciothe iria njathane cia andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli. english: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.

kikuyu: Nĩaakire nyũmba ya gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene, na Nyũmba ya Gũciirĩra, kũrĩa aatuithanagĩria ciira. Nake akĩmĩĩkĩra mbaũ cia mĩtarakwa kuuma thĩ nginya igũrũ.
english: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

kikuyu: na Eliteke, na Gibethoni, na Baalathu,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

kikuyu: Paũlũ akĩrũgama, na aarĩkia kũmakiria na guoko akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Andũ aya a Isiraeli o na inyuĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ arĩa mũhooyaga Ngai, ta thikĩrĩriai!
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩkĩnginyĩrĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Kũngũyagĩrai gĩathĩ kĩu ihinda rĩrĩa rĩtuĩtwo, hwaĩ-inĩ wa mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri ũyũ, kũringana na mawatho makĩo mothe na mũtabarĩre wakĩo.”
english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

kikuyu: Nyũmba yake nĩ njĩra njariĩ ya gũthiĩ mbĩrĩra, nayo yerekagĩria andũ nyũmba-inĩ cia gĩkuũ.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol,† going down to the rooms of death.

kikuyu: Anga mwathĩĩnirio na maũndũ maingĩ ũguo o tũhũ, angĩkorwo ũhoro ũcio wothe warĩ wa tũhũ?
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

kikuyu: Ngai arĩ kũu thĩinĩ wa itũũra rĩu, na rĩtikenyenyeka; Ngai nĩwe ũkaarĩteithia kĩrooko gũgĩkĩa.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

kikuyu: Nake ũrĩa waikarĩire gĩtĩ-kĩa-ũnene akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kwerũhia ndĩrerũhia maũndũ mothe!” Agĩcooka akiuga atĩrĩ, “Andĩka ũndũ ũyũ, nĩgũkorwo ciugo ici nĩ cia kwĩhokwo, na nĩ cia ma.”
english: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Loti akiumagara, agĩthiĩ akĩaria na athoni ake, arĩa maarĩ mahikie airĩtu ake. Akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mwĩhĩkei muume kũndũ gũkũ, nĩ ũndũ Jehova arĩ hakuhĩ kwananga itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene!” No athoni ake magĩĩciiria nĩ itherũ aamaringaga.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

kikuyu: na thaani ĩmwe nene ya thahabu ya ũritũ wa cekeri ikũmi, ĩiyũrĩtio ũbumba;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

kikuyu: “Ta nyoniai mbeeca cianyu. Mbica ĩno na rĩĩtwa rĩĩrĩ nĩ cia ũ?”
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Kũrigania nake, Malikija, ũmwe wa aturi a thahabu, agĩcookereria rũthingo nginya nyũmba-inĩ ya ndungata cia hekarũ na cia onjorithia, kũngʼethera Kĩhingo gĩa Gũtuĩria, na o nginya kanyũmba karĩa kaarĩ igũrũ rĩa koine;
english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Harũni akĩrehe iruta rĩrĩa rĩarĩ rĩa kũrutĩrwo andũ. Akĩoya thenge ĩrĩa ya kũrutĩrwo andũ ĩrĩ iruta rĩa kũmahoroheria mehia akĩmĩthĩnja akĩmĩruta nĩ ũndũ wa iruta rĩa kũhoroheria mehia, o ta ũrĩa ekĩte ĩyo ya mbere.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

kikuyu: Nakuo kũrĩa kũngĩ guothe gwatigaire kũu Gileadi o na Bashani guothe, kũrĩa Ogu aathanaga, ngĩkũhe nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase. (Bũrũri wothe wa Arigobu kũu Bashani hĩndĩ ĩmwe wetagwo bũrũri wa Arefai.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Nĩ kwarĩ na hema yathondeketwo, na kanyũmba kayo ka mbere nĩ haarĩ na mũtĩ ũrĩa wa gũcuuria matawa, na metha, na mĩgate ĩrĩa mĩamũre; hau nĩho heetagwo “Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru.”
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, arĩria andũ anyu, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ngaarehithia rũhiũ rwa njora rũũkĩrĩre bũrũri, nao andũ a bũrũri ũcio
english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

kikuyu: ũthiũ wa Jehova ũũkagĩrĩra andũ arĩa mekaga ũũru, nĩguo moima thĩ matikanaririkanwo.
english: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

kikuyu: Gĩturi-inĩ kĩa o njĩra nĩweyakĩire mahooero matũũgĩru, na ũkĩagithia ũthaka waku gĩtĩĩo, ũgakĩrĩrĩria kũneana mwĩrĩ waku kũrĩ mwĩhĩtũkĩri o wothe atharie nawe.
english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

kikuyu: ũkiuga atĩrĩ, “Andĩka ũrĩa ũkuona ibuku-inĩ rĩa gĩkũnjo, na ũcooke ũũtũmĩre makanitha marĩa mũgwanja: nĩmo kanitha wa Efeso, na wa Simurina, na wa Perigamo, na wa Thuatira, na wa Saride, na wa Filadelifia, na wa Laodikia.”
english: saying,§ “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies:† to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

kikuyu: Ngai agĩcooka akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩagatũma ũhootwo nĩ thũ ciaku. Ũgaacihithũkĩra na njĩra ĩmwe, no ũciũrĩre na njĩra mũgwanja, na nĩ ũgaatuĩka kĩndũ kĩ magigi harĩ mothamaki mothe ma thĩ.
english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa Jehova atũũraga muoyo, o we ũtũmĩte ngaacĩre ũthamaki-inĩ wa baba, Daudi, na agetĩkĩra nduĩke wa rũciaro rwa nyũmba ya ũthamaki, o ta ũrĩa eranĩire-rĩ, Adonija no ekũũragwo ũmũthĩ!”
english: Now therefore as Yahweh lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”

kikuyu: Nakuo guoko kwa andũ a Isiraeli gũgĩkĩrĩrĩria kũgĩa na hinya igũrũ rĩa Jabini, mũthamaki wa andũ a Kaanani, nginya makĩmũniina biũ.
english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mahiga makuo nĩmakenagĩrwo nĩ ndungata ciaku; o na rũkũngũ rwakuo nĩrũtũmaga iringwo nĩ tha.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthĩnja iruta rĩa njino. Nao ariũ ake makĩmũnengera thakame ĩyo, nake akĩmĩminjamin- jĩria kĩgongona mĩena yothe.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩhoota Mũfilisti ũcio na kĩgũtha na kahiga; ndaarĩ na rũhiũ rwa njora guoko-inĩ gwake akĩgũtha Mũfilisti ũcio na akĩmũũraga.
english: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.

kikuyu: Maũndũ ma ũhinya nĩmakũrĩte magatuĩka rũthanju rwa kũherithia waganu; gũtirĩ andũ magaatigara, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wa kĩrĩndĩ kĩu; gũtirĩ ũtonga, na gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩa bata gĩgaatigara.
english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, anĩrĩra mũno, na ndũgakire. Anĩrĩra na mũgambo mũnene o taarĩ karumbeta karagamba.* Uumbũrĩre andũ akwa ũhoro wa ũremi wao, o na andũ a nyũmba ya Jakubu ũmoimbũrĩre mehia mao.
english: Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

kikuyu: Isaaka agĩcookeria Esaũ atĩrĩ, “Ndĩmũtuire mwathi waku na andũ ao othe ndaamatua ndungata ciake, na ndamũhe ngano na ndibei ya mũhihano imũtũũragie. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩ atĩa ingĩhota gũgwĩkĩra, mũrũ wakwa?”
english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

kikuyu: Naguo wega mũingĩ wa Mwathani witũ ũkĩnjiyũrĩrĩra, hamwe na wĩtĩkio o na wendani ũrĩa uumaga thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Saũlũ na andũ ake othe makĩũngana, magĩthiĩ mbaara-inĩ. Magĩkorerera Afilisti marĩ na kĩhĩngĩĩcano kĩnene, magĩtemangana o ene na hiũ cia njora.
english: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.

kikuyu: Niĩ-rĩ, ndiguũrĩirio ũhoro ũcio ũrĩ hitho-inĩ atĩ tondũ ndĩ na ũũgĩ gũkĩra andũ arĩa angĩ matũũraga muoyo, no nĩgeetha wee mũthamaki ũmenye ũrĩa kĩroto kĩu kiugĩte, nĩguo ũtaũkĩrwo nĩ maũndũ macio ũrecũũranagia meciiria-inĩ maku.
english: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ maaiguire watho ũcio, makĩeheria andũ othe arĩa maarĩ ageni kuuma Isiraeli.
english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

kikuyu: Nĩ atĩa ũũĩ ithuĩ tũtooĩ? Nĩ ũmenyo ũrĩkũ ũrĩ naguo ithuĩ tũtarĩ?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo moragĩra andũ a Isiraeli maikũrũkĩte kuuma Bethi-Horoni marorete Azeka-rĩ, Jehova akĩmagũithĩria mahiga manene ma mbura kuuma igũrũ, nao andũ aingĩ makĩũragwo nĩ mahiga macio ma mbura o na gũkĩra arĩa mooragĩtwo nĩ andũ a Isiraeli na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

kikuyu: Kũrigania nake, Baruku mũrũ wa Zabai agĩcookereria gĩcunjĩ kĩngĩ arĩ na kĩyo, kuuma koine- inĩ nginya itoonyero rĩa nyũmba ya Eliashibu mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

kikuyu: o ũndũ ũmwe na tũnyũmba twakĩo twa arangĩri, na thingo ciakĩo, na gĩthaku gĩakĩo, nakĩo kĩarĩ na mĩanya mĩena yothe. Kĩhingo kĩu kĩarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano, na wariĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtano.
english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

kikuyu: andũ arĩa matũũraga nduma-inĩ nĩmonete ũtheri mũnene; nao arĩa matũũraga bũrũri ũrĩ kĩĩruru gĩa gĩkuũ-rĩ, nĩmarĩirwo nĩ ũtheri.”
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”*

kikuyu: No tondũ Jesũ atũũraga muoyo nginya tene-rĩ, ũthĩnjĩri-Ngai wake nĩ wa gũtũũra nginya tene.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũrũme-rĩ, tiwe wombirwo nĩ ũndũ wa mũndũ-wa-nja, no nĩ mũndũ- wa-nja wombirwo nĩ ũndũ wa mũndũ mũrũme.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Shimei maarĩ: Shelomothu, na Hazieli, na Harani, othe maarĩ atatũ. Acio nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia Ladani.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

kikuyu: Niĩ mwene nĩngũtũũra gũkũ Mizipa nĩgeetha ndĩmwaragĩrĩrie kũrĩ andũ a Babuloni arĩa marĩũkaga kũrĩ ithuĩ, no inyuĩ-rĩ, thondekai ndibei, na mũgethage matunda ma hĩndĩ ya riũa,* o na maguta, mwĩigĩre ndigithũ-inĩ cianyu cia mũthiithũ, na mũtũũre matũũra-inĩ marĩa mwĩnyiitĩire.”
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”

kikuyu: Kũrĩhanĩria nĩ gwakwa; nĩ niĩ ngaarĩhanĩria. Ihinda rĩakinya, kũgũrũ kwao nĩ gũgaatenderũka; mũthenya wao wa mwanangĩko ũrĩ hakuhĩ, naguo mũtino wao ũhiũhĩte ũmakore.”
english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio Zadoku ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Nathani ũrĩa mũnabii, na Benaia mũrũ wa Jehoiada, hamwe na Akerethi na Apelethi,† magĩikũrũka, makĩhaicia Solomoni nyũmbũ ya Mũthamaki Daudi, makĩmumagaria nginya Gihoni.
english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

kikuyu: farisai nĩmaiguire atĩ Jesũ nĩagĩĩaga na arutwo aingĩ gũkĩra Johana na akamabatithia,
english: herefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mĩeri ĩtatũ tũkĩhaica marikabu yaikarĩte kũu gĩcigĩrĩra-inĩ hĩndĩ ya heho. Nayo yarĩ marikabu ya kuuma Alekisanderia na yarĩ na rũũri rwa ngai cia mahatha iria cietagwo Kasitori na Poluke.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩigua mũigana wa arĩa meekĩrirwo rũũri, nao maarĩ: 144,000 kuuma mĩhĩrĩga yothe ya Isiraeli.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

kikuyu: Ahiezeri ũrĩa warĩ mũnene wao na Joashu, ariũ a Shemaa ũrĩa Mũgibea; na Jezieli, na Peleti, ariũ a Azimavethu; na Beraka, na Jehu ũrĩa Mũanathothu,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

kikuyu: Thuutha waruo gũũkaga mũgambo wa mũraramo wake; arurumaga na mũgambo wake mũkaru. Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mũgambo wake waiguuo-rĩ, ndarigagĩrĩria heni.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩĩta Johanani mũrũ wa Karea, marĩ na anene othe a mbũtũ cia ita acio maarĩ nake, o na andũ acio angĩ othe kuuma ũrĩa mũnini nginya ũrĩa mũnene, makĩũngana hamwe.
english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

kikuyu: Aarĩkia kwamũkĩra watho ũcio, akĩmaikia kanyũmba ka na thĩinĩ na akĩohithania magũrũ mao na ndungu.
english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

kikuyu: Na kũrĩa andũ matakamũnyiita ũgeni kana marege kũmũthikĩrĩria-rĩ, mũkiuma kuo mũkaaribariba magũrũ manyu rũkũngũ rũitĩke, rũtuĩke ũira wa kũmatuĩra ciira.”
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũkĩgiana na mehia-rĩ, mũtirĩ mũrarũa o nginya mũgaita thakame.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

kikuyu: na ciarĩkia kũniinwo ciehere mbere yaku, wĩmenyerere ndũkanategwo na ũndũ wa gũtuĩria ũhoro wa ngai ciacio ũkĩũria atĩrĩ, “Ĩ ndũrĩrĩ ici itungatagĩra ngai ciacio atĩa? Tũgwĩka o ta ũrĩa ciĩkaga.”
english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

kikuyu: “Tara Alawii† kũringana na nyũmba ciao na mbarĩ ciao. Tara arũme othe arĩa makinyĩtie mweri ũmwe na makĩria.”
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

kikuyu: Nĩmethambaga hĩndĩ ciothe magĩtoonya Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo kana magĩkuhĩrĩria kĩgongona o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Ta thikĩrĩriai ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova, inyuĩ athamaki a Juda, na andũ othe a Juda, na mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa ũtũũraga Jerusalemu, ũrĩa ũtoonyagĩra ihingo-inĩ ici.
english: Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Rubeni mũrĩmo wa Jorodani mwena wa irathĩro wa Jeriko, makĩheo Bezeri werũ-inĩ, na Jahaza,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Ariũ a Nuhu maarĩ: Shemu, na Hamu, na Jafethu. Ariũ a Jafethu
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Na nĩ ũndũ wa gũkaanio na kĩroto matigacookere kwa Herode, magĩcooka bũrũri wao magereire njĩra ĩngĩ. Kũũrĩra Bũrũri wa Misiri
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

kikuyu: Na hwaĩ-inĩ wakinya-rĩ, mũndũ warĩ gĩtonga wa kuuma Arimathea, wetagwo Jusufu, ũrĩa watuĩkĩte mũrutwo wa Jesũ agĩũka.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

kikuyu: Zila o nake aarĩ na mũriũ, nake eetagwo Tubali-Kaini, na nĩwe waturaga indo cia mĩthemba yothe cia gĩcango na cia kĩgera. Tubali-Kaini aarĩ na mwarĩ wa nyina wetagwo Naama.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

kikuyu: Alawii othe arũme a ũkũrũ wa mweri ũmwe na makĩria arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 23,000. Matiataranĩirio hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli arĩa angĩ tondũ matiagaire kĩndũ hamwe na andũ arĩa angĩ.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Andũ marokũgooca, Wee Ngai; andũ othe marogũkumia.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Musa ndungata ya Jehova hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli nĩmamatooririe. Nake Musa ndungata ya Jehova akĩheana bũrũri wao kũrĩ andũ a Rubeni, na a Gadi, na nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase, gũtuĩke igai rĩao.
english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Nĩngekĩra ngũũrani gatagatĩ ka andũ akwa na aku. Rũciũ nĩrĩo kĩama gĩkĩ gĩgekĩka.’ ”
english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmatiga, agĩthiĩ, akĩhooya rĩngĩ riita rĩa gatatũ, akiuga ciugo o ro icio.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩmarekereria marũmĩrĩre ũremi wa ngoro ciao, na marũmagĩrĩre mwĩĩro wao ene.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

kikuyu: ĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nyũmba ya Jehova Ngai ĩgaakwo haha, o na kĩgongona gĩa kũrutagĩrwo maruta ma njino nĩ Isiraeli.” Kũhaarĩria Mwako wa Hekarũ
english: hen David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

kikuyu: Nake Isaia akĩĩra Hezekia atĩrĩ, “Ta igua kiugo kĩa Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe:
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ti-itherũ ihinda nĩrĩgooka rĩrĩa ngaaherithia ngai cia mĩhianano ya Babuloni; bũrũri ũcio wothe nĩũgaconorithio, nao andũ akuo arĩa othe moragĩtwo nĩmakaaragana kuo.
english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũndũ-wa-nja watũũrĩte mũtũũrĩre wa mehia itũũra-inĩ rĩu aamenyire atĩ Jesũ nĩararĩa irio nyũmba ya Mũfarisai ũcio-rĩ, agĩũka na cuba wa maguta manungi wega,
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

kikuyu: Nao athĩnjĩri- Ngai magĩcooka magĩthĩnja thenge icio hamwe na thakame yacio, magĩcirutĩra hau kĩgongona-inĩ irĩ maruta ma kũhoroheria mehia nĩguo ihoroherie andũ a Isiraeli othe, nĩ tondũ mũthamaki nĩathanĩte kũrutwo iruta rĩa njino na iruta rĩa kũhoroheria mehia rĩrĩ rĩa andũ othe a Isiraeli.
english: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

kikuyu: Ithandũkũ rĩu rĩgemio na thahabu therie mĩena yeerĩ nja na thĩinĩ, na mũrĩtirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu mĩena yothe.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Kwĩnyiihia na gwĩtigĩra Jehova kũrehaga ũtonga, na gĩtĩĩo, na muoyo.
english: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ageni othe a Adonija makĩmaka, magĩũkĩra, magĩĩthiĩra, o mũndũ na njĩra yake.
english: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.

kikuyu: nayo thũ ĩrĩa ĩrĩhaandaga nĩ ũrĩa mũũru. Magetha nĩ ithirĩro rĩa mahinda maya, na agethi nĩ araika.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

kikuyu: ake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Arĩria athĩnjĩri-Ngai, nĩo ariũ a Harũni, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Mũthĩnjĩri- Ngai ndakanethaahie nĩ ũndũ wa mũndũ wao ũkuĩte,
english: ahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa aamenyithirio nĩ mũnene ũcio wa thigari igana atĩ nĩguo kwarĩ, agĩĩtĩkĩria Jusufu akuue mwĩrĩ ũcio.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

kikuyu: na ũritũ wa thahabu therie ya gũthondeka hũũma, na mbakũri cia kũminjaminjĩria, na nyũngũ, ũritũ wa thahabu ya gũthondeka o thaani ya thahabu; na ũritũ wa betha ya gũthondeka o thaani ya betha;
english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

kikuyu: Itihatĩkanaga ĩmwe na ĩrĩa ĩngĩ; o ĩmwe ĩthiiaga yerekeire mbere. Itoonyaga kũrĩa kũgitĩre, gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩngĩcigiria.
english: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.

kikuyu: Irĩma igĩtũhatũũha ta ndũrũme,
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

kikuyu: Ndũkanaahũke na mwena wa ũrĩo kana wa ũmotho; eheria kũgũrũ gwaku kuuma ũũru-inĩ.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

kikuyu: Nĩmahũũrire thahabu makĩmĩtua tũbaati tũhũthu, magĩtũtinangia nguucio cia gũtumanio na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njega, wĩra wa mũbundi mũũgĩ.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Ihinda-inĩ o rĩu gĩkundi kĩnene kĩa Ayahudi gĩkĩmenya atĩ Jesũ aarĩ kũu na gĩgĩũka, na gĩtiokire nĩ ũndũ wa Jesũ tu, no ningĩ nĩgeetha kĩone o na Lazaro ũcio aariũkĩtie kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kikuyu: No Eri, irigithathi rĩa Juda, aarĩ mwaganu maitho-inĩ ma Jehova; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩmũũraga.
english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.

kikuyu: To arĩa akũrũ oiki oogĩ, na to arĩa akũrũ mamenyaga ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

kikuyu: Arĩa maarĩ aini, na atongoria a nyũmba cia Alawii, maaikaraga tũnyũmba-inĩ kũu hekarũ thĩinĩ na matiarutaga mawĩra mangĩ tondũ maarĩ a kũmenyerera wĩra ũcio wao mũthenya na ũtukũ.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa itũũra rĩu inene no mwanangĩko ũrĩ kuo; kwĩhĩtanĩra na kũheenania ciyũrĩte njĩra-inĩ ciarĩo.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

kikuyu: Ririkanai atĩ mwarĩ ngombo kũu bũrũri wa Misiri, na mũrũmagĩrĩre wega irĩra icio cia watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

kikuyu: Mũthoni-we, ithe wa mũirĩtu ũcio, akĩmũringĩrĩria aikare; nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩikara hamwe nake mĩthenya ĩtatũ, arĩĩaga na akanyua, na agakoma kuo.
english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

kikuyu: Mũndũ-wa-nja agĩciara nĩakoragwo na ruo tondũ hĩndĩ yake nĩ nginyu; no aarĩkia gũciara kaana, akariganĩrwo nĩ ruo nĩ ũndũ wa gũkena nĩgũkorwo kaana nĩ gaaciarwo gũkũ thĩ.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

kikuyu: Ũrorathimwonĩũndũwaitua rĩakurĩeganakũngiriandigaitethakameũmũthĩ, na ndikerĩhĩrie na moko makwa.
english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

kikuyu: ĩ niĩ Paũlũ, ndungata ya Ngai na mũtũmwo wa Jesũ Kristũ. Ndũmĩtwo nĩguo andũ arĩa athuure nĩ Ngai mongererwo wĩtĩkio na ũmenyo wa kũmenya ũhoro-ũrĩa-wa-ma ũrĩa ũtwaranĩte na ũhoro wa kwĩyamũrĩra Ngai,
english: aul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ,† according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũmwe, rĩrĩa aahooyaga arĩ hekarũ-inĩ ya ngai yake Nisiroku, ariũ ake eerĩ Adarameleki na Sharezeru makĩmũũraga na rũhiũ rũa njora, na makĩũrĩra bũrũri wa Ararati. Nake mũriũ Esari-Hadoni agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Gibeoni makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Tũtiagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũũria tũheo betha kana thahabu kuuma kũrĩ Saũlũ, kana nyũmba yake, o na tũtirĩ na kĩhooto gĩa kũũraga mũndũ o na ũmwe thĩinĩ wa Isiraeli.” Daudi akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩatĩa mũngĩenda ndĩmwĩkĩre?”
english: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

kikuyu: Mũndũ akua-rĩ, nĩagatũũra muoyo rĩngĩ? Matukũ makwa mothe ma wĩra mũritũ-rĩ, ngweterera ihinda rĩakwa rĩa kwerũhĩrio hinya rĩkinye.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

kikuyu: na Hadoramu, na Uzali, na Dikila,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo nĩndoiga ũũru-rĩ, heana ũira wa ũũru ũcio. No angĩkorwo ndaaria ũhoro wa ma-rĩ, wangũthĩra kĩ?”
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

kikuyu: Baba ũrĩa waheire cio, nĩ mũnene kũrĩ othe; gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩcigutha kuuma moko-inĩ ma Baba.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, andĩka maũndũ marĩa wona, marĩa marĩ kuo rĩu na marĩa magooka thuutha-inĩ.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

kikuyu: Matũũra marĩa manene ma Aroeri nĩmagatiganĩrio, matigĩrwo ndũũru cia mbũri iria igaakomaga kũu, gũtarĩ mũndũ wa gũcimakia.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.

kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Manase (na nĩguo mũhĩrĩga wa Jusufu), aarĩ Gadi mũrũ wa Susi;
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ ũkuue betha na thahabu, iriamũthamakinaataariakemaheanĩtenakwĩyenderakũrĩNgaiwaIsiraeliũrĩaũtũũraga Jerusalemu,
english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Kuuma hĩndĩ ĩyo, arutwo ake aingĩ makĩhũndũka, na matiacookire kũmũrũmĩrĩra.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

kikuyu: o mũrũmĩtie kiugo kĩa muoyo, nĩguo ngaagĩa na ũndũ wa kwĩrahĩra mũthenya ũrĩa wa Kristũ atĩ ndiahanyũkire tũhũ kana ngĩruta wĩra ngĩnoga tũhũ.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

kikuyu: Nyamũ icio na ngai icio cia kũhooywo irainamĩrĩra hamwe; ciothe ikaremwo nĩkũhonokia mĩhianano ĩyo ĩkuuĩtwo, nacio nyene igatahwo igatwarwo ũkombo-inĩ.
english: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.

kikuyu: Joabu akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee tiwe wagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũtwara ũhoro ũcio ũmũthĩ. Reke ũgaatwara ũhoro ihinda rĩngĩ, no ndũgwĩka ũguo ũmũthĩ, tondũ mũrũ wa mũthamaki nĩakuĩte.”
english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

kikuyu: Daudi akĩũria mwanake ũcio wamũreheire ũhoro atĩrĩ, “Wee uumĩte kũ?” Nake agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Niĩ ndĩ mũriũ wa mũndũ wa kũngĩ, Mũamaleki.”
english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”

kikuyu: “Mweri ũyũ nĩguo ũgũtuĩka mweri wa mbere harĩ inyuĩ, ũtuĩke mweri wa mbere wa mwaka wanyu.
english: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

kikuyu: Hooyai nĩgeetha ngaahonokio kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa matetĩkĩtie a kũu Judea, na ningĩ atĩ ũtungata wakwa kũu Jerusalemu ũgetĩkĩrĩka nĩ andũ arĩa aamũre akuo,
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

kikuyu: Nĩaturumithie ũthiũ wake rũkũngũ-inĩ, no gũkorwo aahota kũgĩa na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro.
english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Abimeleku akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ atĩa ũguo ũtwĩkĩte? Ĩ mũndũ mũrũme ũmwe wa gũkũ angĩrakorirwo akomete na mũtumia waku, nawe ũgĩtũme tũnyiitwo nĩ ihĩtia?”
english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

kikuyu: Hakĩrĩ ũguo-rĩ, angĩkorwo Demeterio na andũ acio angĩ marutaga wĩra nake marĩ na mateta igũrũ rĩa mũndũ o wothe, maciirĩro nĩmahingũre na aciirithania marĩ ho. No mamathitange.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene akĩrũgama gatagatĩ kao, akĩũria Jesũ atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ wee ũtarĩ na ũndũ ũngĩcookia? Nĩ ũhoro ũrĩkũ ũyũ ũrathitangwo naguo?”
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Wee ũrĩ mwega, na nĩwĩkaga o wega; nduta kĩrĩra kĩa watho waku.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Andũ a thĩ acio angĩ, arĩa matooragirwo nĩ mĩthiro ĩyo, matiigana kwĩrira mehia ma wĩra wa moko mao; matiigana gũtiga kũhooya ndaimono, na mĩhianano ya thahabu, na ya betha, na ya gĩcango, na ya mahiga, na ya mĩtĩ, o mĩhianano ĩrĩa ĩtangĩhota kuona, kana ĩigue, kana ĩĩtware.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo andũ arĩa Jehova aathanire makaagaĩra andũ a Isiraeli magai mao kũu bũrũri wa Kaanani.
english: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: “Thiĩ o rĩmwe nginya Zarefathu kũu Sidoni ũgaikare kuo. Nĩnjathĩte mũtumia wa ndigwa wa kũu akũheage irio.”
english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

kikuyu: Nake agĩatha mũndũ ũcio aatũmire atĩrĩ: “Warĩkia kũhe mũthamaki ũhoro ũyũ wothe wa mbaara,
english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

kikuyu: Ciarĩkia kũrĩa tũhuti tuothe, bũrũri ũgĩthera biũ, ngĩkaya ngiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwathani Jehova, marekere! Jakubu-rĩ, angĩhonoka gĩkuũ atĩa? Nĩgũkorwo nĩ mũnini mũno!”
english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa athĩĩni marĩrĩĩaga na makahũũna, arĩa marongoragia Jehova, nĩmarĩmũgoocaga; ngoro cianyu irotũũra nginya tene.
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũkwenda ndĩmwĩkĩre atĩa?”
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: “Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ekuuga atĩrĩ; ‘Thuutha wa kahinda kanini nĩngathingithia igũrũ na thĩ rĩngĩ, na thingithie iria na thĩ nyũmũ.
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

kikuyu: matarĩtwo na mbarĩ ciao, maarĩ andũ 2,750
english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

kikuyu: “O ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo Watho-inĩ, nĩtũrĩĩrehaga marigithathi maitũ ma aanake, na ma ngʼombe, na ma ndũũru cia ngʼombe na cia mbũri ciitũ gũkũ nyũmba-inĩ ya Ngai witũ kũrĩ athĩnjĩri- Ngai arĩa matungataga kuo.
english: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;
